name: 31 Tonka Bodykon
description: Theme 31: Tonka Sweet Amber A sweet amber creation, a highly desirable, liquorous Tonka bean. THE INSPIRATION An aphrodisiac, “skin-tight“, shimmering tonka… The word “bodycon” may not sound very flattering, but the concept behind it is. The term bodycon is actually a contraction of the words ‘body’ and ‘conscious’, which means body-conscious . Tonka Bodykon is an aphrodisiac, “skin-tight”, shimmering tonka that follows the body’s curves as closely as possible to highlight them. THE PERFUME Tonka Bodykon is a soft amber composition centred on the tonka bean. Inspired by the chromatic palette of a sunset setting the horizon, this fragrance is a “tonka liqueur” infused with balsam and fruity notes. Intoxicating and fiery, we imagine it shimmering on the body of a divinity performing a fire dance, billowing its veils in the evening light. THE NAME TONKA BODYKON, the term “bodycon” written with the “k” of tonka.

name: 312 Saint Honore
description: “For the opening of my first flagship store in Paris, I wanted to celebrate this new chapter with a creation in honor of this Parisian address. The inspiration of this perfume comes from the raw materials that were selected to create the boutique : the glass of the window, the concrete and the white stone from Bourgogne which bring some freshness and light into the space. They give all together a mineral design approach, like the perfume. 312 Saint-Honoré is composed of pink peppercorn notes for an addictive spicy opening. At the heart of the fragrance, white musks, amber musks and lactones mingle with the freshness of orange blossom. In the base notes, you will find a sensual and animalic accord. With Alexandra Carlin, we imagined a fragrance that could be worn at any time of the day and for all seasons." David Benedek

name: Above the Waves EDP
description: Above the Waves is our first creation inspired by tea, a luminous blend of three rare varieties, infused with bright bergamot and profound cedar. It invites you into a moment suspended between earth and sky, where scent becomes ritual. This is not just a perfume, it’s a ceremony in a bottle. The scent opens with the crisp clarity of green tea leaves, lifted by aromatic incense and cardamom and grounded in the subtle warmth of infused woods. Fresh yet meditative, light yet anchoring, it accompanies you like a gentle tide, always moving, always present. Above the Waves is a tribute to what protects us, carries us, and connects us to something greater. A fragrance that offers not only freshness, but also a sense of calm, perspective, and elevation, like standing above the sea, with a clear view of your path ahead.

name: Almafolia EDP
description: Almafolia is a declaration of presence. A fragrance that seduces, captivates, and leaves an indelible mark. It is a long-lasting, enveloping perfume, rich in creamy floral nuances. It opens with luminous tuberose wrapped in juicy notes of sweet orange and peach. At its heart, tuberose returns deeper and more sensual, embraced by jasmine, white rose, ylang-ylang, coconut, and rosewood. The base is a warm embrace of amber, vanilla pods, benzoin, and white musk, weaving an intense and seductive trail.

name: Amber Musk
description: Can you imagine a fragrance that doesn't overwhelm the entire body? Like a caress, Amber Musk arouses a thrill, an emotion. A mysterious and carnal fragrance, that intertwines Musk and Ambergris in a dance of the senses.

name: Amore Caffe
description: Whoever it was in Italy that first thought to immerse a ball of vanilla ice cream in a bath of hot espresso, they were most likely searching for some rich and insatiable fullness. Amore Caffè finds its inspiration in this delirious gesture of mixing delicious opposites. Prepare to ebb and flow between sips of astringent cafe noir and whippings of lush, sweet cream. Twist it with a hint of Amaretto and speculoos, on a bed of grey amber, vanilla pod and brown sugar, and yes, you are here in full satisfaction.

name: Blossom Love EDP W 100ml
description: This is a romantic fragrance representing modern femininity. The light, sweet, and delicate nature of the Cherry Blossom Nectar reveals boldness when it's combined with the Rose Liquor to create a rich and sensual tone tinted with the mysterious sophistication of Ylang Ylang. This floral passion is wrapped with the gourmand appeal of amaretto, tonka bean and vanilla before diving into the sandalwood and cashmeran to create an intense and lasting olfactive trail.

name: Dia EDP M 100ml
description: Dia Man is an elegant day wear to complement Amouage Gold, this well-rounded chypre fragrance is a fine example of tasteful subtlety.

name: Epic 56 Extrait W 100 ml
description: A sublime union of extreme concentration and extended aging, this iconic creation becomes all the more extraordinary. With an exceptional 56% perfume oil concentration, Epic 56 Woman revisits the legends of the Silk Road, uncovering a deeper story of the critically acclaimed Epic Eau de Parfum. After close to five months of aging, the quality of its signature notes - Rose, Spices, Frankincense, and Woods - is accentuated by a deeper and more complex ambery construction, leaving a lasting impression on the senses. Some fragrances can also contain a bit of water and additives like liquid UV filters, stabilizers, or colorants. Therefore, fragrances with a higher fragrance concentration contain more perfume oils and less alcohol, and vice-versa. name: Epic EDP W 100ml
description: This spicy oriental fragrance is inspired by the eternal legends of the ancient Silk Road from China to Arabia.

name: Guidance
description: THE DELICATE STRENGTH OF FEMININITY A spellbinding and novel interpretation of the Amouage triad of Rose, Frankincense and Ambergris, Guidance reads like a poem, smells like an embrace, and feels like a word of wisdom. An ivory tower wreathed in shreds of clouds, dewy mists of fragile Pear, inviting Almond Milk and beads of Frankincense draw the outlines of a dreamful haven. A princess whispers you in and leads the way to a lush garden where Osmanthus blossoms diffuse their heady apricot scent. A fountain gleams in the centre, its marble edge covered in scarlet roses whose voluptuous scent meets that of leathery Saffron threads laid on the floor. Through Jasmine screens, sultry and spent, the woman walks and there comes with her a scent of dark Vanilla and skinlike Sandalwood, of ambery Labdanum and purring hints of regal Ambergris: who are you, she asks, and you feel seen. Perfumer: Quentin Bisch

name: Guidance 46 Extrait
description: Enthralling and beguiling, Guidance 46 Exceptional Extrait is a study in light and shade, fragility and strength, subtlety and ostentatiousness - paradoxes brought together with an immediacy that can be achieved only by the art of perfumery and dosed at a staggering 46% concentration.

name: Honour 43 Extrait W 100ml
description: Like poetry in motion - formulated slowly and with intent, this precious elixir is an awakening for the senses. Honor 43 Woman elevates Amouage’s heady white floral perfume inspired by Madame Butterfly to new heights. Presented in a 43% perfume oil concentration, a quartet of white flowers - Jasmine, Tuberose, Gardenia, Lily of the Valley - come together in a showstopping crescendo, revealing a more harmonized and smoother rendition of this iconic scent. What makes Honour 43 Woman an "Exceptional Extrait"? A fragrance is usually a mix of a concentrate (containing fragrant oils) and an alcoholic base. Some fragrances can also contain a bit of water and additives like liquid UV filters, stabilizers, or colorants. Therefore, fragrances with a higher fragrance concentration contain more perfume oils and less alcohol, and vice-versa. name: Honour EDP W 100ml
description: Honour Woman is a white floral fragrance inspired by the tragic predicament of Madame Butterfly. In honour of truth and beauty, her poetic love and sorrow echo eternally.

name: Interlude EDP M 100ml
description: Interlude Man by luxury fragrance house Amouage is inspired by chaos and disorder, this spicy and woody fragrance masquerades an interlude moment of harmony in its heart.

name: Jubilation XXV EDP M 100ml
description: Amouage Jubilation XXV is created for the enigmatic man carrying the essence of his philosophy and sophistication across all eras and cultures.

name: Love Delight EDP
description: The interplay of delicate florals and irresistible treats; radiance and insouciance. Love Delight is an invitation to savour a moment of indulgence. "For Love Delight, I was inspired by the uniquely fragrant atmosphere of bakeries in Muscat and the surrounding region of Oman. When Arabian sweets come fresh out of the oven, the air is infused with the perfume of warm, baked cake, alongside roasted nuts, saffron, cardamom, cinnamon, orange flower and rose water." - Renaud Salmon, Amouage. Aging Period: 7 weeks Perfumer: Pascal Gaurin

name: Meander EDP M 100ml
description: Meander explores the exhilarating feeling of happiness in a land of fog, lush green mountains, and running streams. Drawing inspiration from the Sultanate's southernmost Governorate during the monsoon (Khareef) season, Amouage creatively translated the surreal fog using Frankincense and smoky Vetiver, the rich greens with Cypriol and Jonquille, while its caramel-colored mud is brought to life with earthy Sandalwood, Carrot Heart, and Orris root notes.

name: Opus XIV Royal Tobacco
description: One of knowledge and aesthetic pleasure, Opus XIV - Royal Tobacco is a fragrant journey along the Tropic of Cancer from Oman to Cuba, connecting Royal Frankincense to Regal Tobacco. The perfume references the tradition of ‘El Lector’, whose role was to read to cigarmakers in Cuban factories, captivating them with riveting novels like Les Misérables by Victor Hugo and works by Honoré de Balzac, Stendhal, Edgar Allan Poe or Herman Melville until it became an honored ritual as synonymous with the rolling floor as the scent of tobacco. Interpreted by renowned perfumer Cécile Zarokian, a unique accord of Frankincense and Tobacco bursts alive in a novel and rich sensory experience.

name: Purpose
description: A vertical totem of mineral woods and stellar sparks of spice, Purpose is a shamanic awakening, the scent of feeling at peace of finding your roots, of being complete. A brisk Bergamot washes over you like a draft of glacial air. You feel the cold grip of Pink Pepper, the slight tingle of Pimento Berry in your fingers, and a Frankincense encapsulating your past and your future. A deep breath fills your lungs with the fierce and smoky scent of Sand Vetiver and of an animalic Rose whose weathered tobacco accents tame the tension between an earthy Papyrus and a silken touch of Sandalwood. Yet this is the roads’ end, where the sun is always high, and rays of aldehydic Mystikal suddenly spear through Saffron and Suede, your leathery cloak of doubts, to kindle a mist of Akigalawood, shimmering like a swarm of fireflies. Perfumer: Quentin Bisch

name: Reflection 45 Extrait M 100ml
description: Products Amouage Reflection 45 Extrait M 100 ml Amouage Reflection 45 Extrait M 100 ml Images & videos Product info Basic info Name Ribbon New Description Being given the gift of time, this contemporary perfume is richer, more potent and highly sought after. With a generous 45% concentration of perfume oil, Reflection 45 Man breaks new ground on this woody floral musk scent. Maturated and macerated for four months, it boldly reinterprets one of the House’s iconic signatures through spicy top notes and textured florals that are designed to transcend time and place. What makes Reflection 45 Man an "Exceptional Extrait"? A fragrance is usually a mix of a concentrate (containing fragrant oils) and an alcoholic base. Some fragrances can also contain a bit of water and additives like liquid UV filters, stabilizers or colourants. name: Reflection EDP M 100ml
description: Amouage Reflection for Man embodies the spirit of refinement and is compelling, distinctive and unmistakably masculine with a timeless appeal.

name: Search
description: A tale of trying and reaching, of life overcoming shade, Search captures the virile energy of resilient minds unafraid to fight their inner darkness to become their ideal self. It is at first a flash of Lemon, insanely vibrant and bright, striking like lightning in the middle of the night. Fluttering notes of Lime, lively and shrill, soon come forth, welded into the metallic zing of Mandarin, its leathery zest and bittersweetness. Shackled in a cage of dark woods, the Citrus fight with a newfound strength, their light shining brighter as delicate notes of Elemi and a heavenly touch of Hojari Frankincense burst open. Even as the smoke rises and crashes in waves of burnt Cade, spicy Guaiacwood and incandescent Vetiver, the Citrus bouquet carries its brilliance proud, undefeated, and undimmed. Perfumer: Alexis Grugeon

name: Aoud Lemon Mint
description: This fresh, sweet cocktail is inspired by the flavours and aromas of Cuba.

name: Arabesque EDP
description: Joining Ormonde Jayne's Four Corners of the Earth collection, Arabesque takes you on an olfactory journey through the enchanting and mystical Middle East, based on flowers, fruits and woods entwined together and found in Islamic art. The top note is a vivacious and energetic blackcurrant skilfully blended with a citrusy aroma of bergamot and a spicy shot of black pepper. Arabesque’s heart lies in rose and jasmine absolutes, interplaying beautifully, creating a sense of well-being and serenity. A powerhouse of base notes, musk, moss, patchouli and Oudh form a classic foundation for the complex scent to build upon its interlacing rhythmic foliage.

name: Arabians Tonka
description: Arabians Tonka, intended for lovers of rare perfumes, is the complice of Arabians, a tribute fragrance to the Arabic Horse. A fine blend of spiced volutes, bewitching Roses, Tonka Bean and Bergamot reveal an animal temperament of Oud, Amber and Musk. An audacious, racy and fiery fragrance, with an almost feminine look.

name: Athenais
description: Athenais opens with sparkling notes of neroli and yuzu, followed by a luminous heart of orange blossom, settling on a warm and addictive tonka bean powdery base. Flamboyant, charming and vivacious.

name: Ave Maria
description: Fruity Floral Celebratory - Ethereal A beaming ode to love and devotion. Ave María captures the essence of magnetic beauty and luminous grace. Opening with dewy gardenia, its floral heart blooms with African neroli before settling into the intoxicating depth of a merlot wine accord. This fragrance embodies a universe where love radiates endlessly, tethered to the earth yet reaching for the divine. She is magnetic, drawing in beauty and light—she is Ave María.

name: Bouquet De Hongrie
description: 1. Bouquet de Hongrie takes its inspiration from a springtime moment in the gardens of the Palais-Royal. 2. The perfume is also a nod to David Benedek’s grandparents’ village on the border between Romania and Hungary. 3. Floral, green and musky. 4. Recommended for those in search of a floral, delicate, and sensual perfume.

name: Creme De Cuir
description: 1. Crème de Cuir is inspired by the painter Rothko’s beige and white monochromes. 2. Free from any animal notes, Crème de Cuir is like white suede brushing delicately against the skin. The top note is freshened by mandarin, pineapple, and bergamot leaves. 3. Citrusy, vanilla, and musky leather. 4. Recommended for those in search of a skin scent: leathery, fresh and sensual.

name: Gris Charnel
description: 1. Gris Charnel is inspired by a Parisian urban sensuality, which it expresses through sandalwood and vetiver. 2. It is the scent of bodies entwined between white sheets until the early morning. 3. Woody, spicy and powdery. 4. Recommended for those in search of a carnal, amber and woody perfume.

name: Pas Ce Soir
description: 1. Pas ce Soir is inspired by a mysterious and sensual night in Paris. 2. Fruity, spicy and woody. 3. A trilogy of jasmine, quince and orange blossom. 4. Recommended for those in search of an indulgent floral perfume.

name: Rouge Smoking
description: 1. Rouge Smoking is inspired by the Pigalle district, blending sweetness and vivacity. 2. A spicy top note of pink peppercorn is set against the freshness of bergamot. The cherry pit accord is accompanied by black vanilla absolute, tonka bean and white musks. 3. Fruity, ambery and spicy. 4. Recommended for those in search of an ambery, musky perfume. 5. Rouge Smoking reached the finals of the FiFi Awards France in June 2019 in the category of Best Perfume by an Independent Niche Brand.

name: Tubereuse Imperiale
description: 1. Tubéreuse Impériale is a solar perfume dominated by tuberose. 2. Around the tuberose dances a bouquet of white flowers, composed of ylang-ylang, jasmine, and iris. 3. Floral, solar, and woody. Leaves behind it a sensual and opulent sillage. 4. Recommended for those in search of an oriental and floral perfume.

name: Vanille Leather
description: 1 - Exalted vanilla leather. 2 - Tuberose, jasmine, and orange blossom merge in sensuality. 3 - White flowers elixir accompanied by a precious vanilla of Madagascar. 4 - Smoky leather and woody accords reconstructed from oak wood essence and patchouli. "My intention was to combine the precious vanilla pod with a bouquet of white flowers to slowly reveal its warm and sensual personality. The vanilla is adorned with the sulfurous and slightly honeyed tones of tuberose, then drinks in the powerful sweetness of jasmine and finally melts into the round, carnal notes of orange blossom. To intensify the trail, I chose to work around the notes of oak wood and patchouli." - Dominique Ropion

name: Velvet Tonka
description: 1. The Velvet Tonka perfume is built around a trilogy of tonka bean, almond, and orange blossom on an amber background. 2. Velvet Tonka takes its inspiration from oriental delicacies dusted with icing sugar. A honeyed, amber of amyris wood and tobacco intensifies the woody and almondy facets of the tonka bean, giving it a powdery, addictive sillage. 3. Amber, vanilla and woody. 4. Recommended for people looking for an addictive, almondy, and sensual fragrance.

name: Villa Neroli
description: 1. Villa Néroli is inspired by the beauty of the landscape of Capri island in Italy. An ode to la dolce vita. 2. The essence of neroli blends in the top with the freshness of petitgrain and lemon. Accompanied by orange blossom absolute and rosy notes, vanilla absolute creates a sensual and comforting trail. 3. Amber, floral and woody. 4. Recommended for people looking for an orange blossom fragrance, sparkling and luminous. A sensual fragrance that invites us to travel.

name: Pas Ce Soir Extrait
description: Like its original signature, Pas ce Soir Extrait evokes the Parisian mystery and sensuality. Concentrated at 30%, this more faceted creation is addictive and gourmand. Cocoa blends with the spicy freshness of black pepper and ginger. The voluptuous notes of peach complement the fruity sweetness of quince chutney and orange blossom. At the base, the essence of patchouli and vanilla bring power and depth. An intoxicating trail of floral and fruity accents.

name: Bianco Latte EDP
description: Bianco Latte by Giardini di Toscana: the cuddle, the hug, the pleasure of being wrapped in a cloud of vanilla, milk, and honey.

name: Bianco Oro EDP
description: Bianco Oro is pure magnetism. The fragrance of those who love to stand out, to enter with confi dence and embrace being noticed. Sensual, intriguing, intense. A persistent, enveloping scent built on the perfect balance of elegance and sensuality. It opens with the sparkling brightness of pink pepper and bergamot, before unveiling an elegant heart of absolute rose and black pepper. The base is opulent and ambery, with patchouli, cetalox, and javanol adding warmth and depth, leaving behind a powerful and enduring trail.

name: Black Guava Extrait Extrême
description: The fragrance bursts with the juicy brightness of guava, spiced with cardamom and the zesty kick of mandarin from Madagascar. As the heart unfolds, the floral elegance of rose and geranium is consumed by the dark richness of oud, creating a stunning contrast of sweet and smoky. In the base, earthy patchouli, smoky cypriol, and the animalic allure of grey amber form a brooding, resinous foundation. Together, these elements create a fragrance that feels alive—a captivating interplay of radiance and shadow.

name: Black Mango Extrait Extrême
description: Black Mango is the essence of indulgence and desire, bottled. It opens with the juicy sweetness of ripe mango and the zesty brightness of orange essential oil, instantly flooding your senses like biting into a perfectly ripe mango. As the scent deepens, the creamy richness of mango lassi blends with the warm, seductive notes of bourbon vanilla and resinous tolu, evoking a delicious, irresistible pull. But it doesn’t stop there—the base dives into the dark, smoky allure of oud, supple leather, earthy sandalwood, and spicy cypriol. Black Mango captures the raw, primal pleasure of savoring every last bite, down to the core—bold, addictive, and unforgettable.

name: Black Vetiver
description: Fresh and bracing, the leaves of the lemon tree give Black Vetiver a clean and smooth opening. Combined with the lemon tree, Javanese vetiver, and a subtle tar note, creates an elegant contrast between fresh and smoky woody notes. Pimento and Jamaican vetiver create a stylized and sophisticated finish that is wonderfully crisp and raw.

name: Blu Indaco EDP
description: Blu Indaco is like the perfect white shirt: timeless, refined, impeccable. A modern, sophisticated, and clean fragrance that leaves a trail with balance and personality. This is a unisex, long-lasting perfume, built on a refined contrast between freshness and depth. The opening blends bergamot, pink pepper, and iris, which imparts a delicate powdery softness, the fragrance’s signature. At its heart, almond, both sweet and bitter, melts into a bath of vanilla, creating rounded, velvety sensuality. Modern musky molecules in the base ensure a clean and persistent trail, ideal for those seeking elegance with lasting presence.

name: Blu Mare EDP
description: Blu Mare is a journey to the sea. From the Tuscan inland, through cypress groves and pine forests, until it meets the vast, salty depths of blue. It evokes anticipation, desire, landscapes crossed and longed for. A unisex, persistent, and distinctive fragrance, defined by the dynamic contrast of green and marine notes. The opening is bright and citrusy, with bergamot, lemon, grapefruit, and a spicy touch of pink pepper. At its heart, a marine accord merges with cypress, conjuring the meeting of pinewood and sea. Ambergris and oakmoss in the base create an elegant, structured, and profound trail.

name: Blue Talisman
description: A hypnotic jewel BLUE TALISMAN is a mesmerizing fragrance, designed as a hypnotic jewel and a lucky charm for the skin. It reflects EX NIHILO’s boldness, capturing the essence of Place Vendôme—near where the house was born. With its vanguard spirit, this scent reveals enchanting facets that invite exploration and intrigue. A true olfactory statement, it embodies the sophistication and allure of timeless elegance. Perfumer: Jordi Fernández

name: Bois Datchai EDP
description: Forest races, crispy wild berries, tangy brambles, summery times. First one home. Cheeky games, smoky tea, spicy bark. Silvery reeds, lively embers, fruity seeds. A crimson moon. The defining adventure : a taste of spicy black tea and wild berries in the heart of a primitive forest. The surprising contrast : crisp and lively berries contrast with smoky and enchanting woods. Fragrance family : woody fruity. Key raw materials : blackcurrant bud absolute, black tea absolute, cinnamon essential oil, patchouli essential oil, cedar essential oil, leather accord. Concentration : 18%

name: Bois Impérial
description: Perfumer: Quentin Bisch Freshly crushed and spicy Thai Basil leaves meet the sparkling peppery and grapefruit facets of Nepalese Timut Pepper absolute. A brilliant combination that contrasts perfectly with the bold woody signature of the fragrance. A green, rich and earthy Haitian Vetiver oil echoes with Georgywood – an exclusive molecule with powerful cedarwood tones. This vibrating woody association is illuminated by the sophisticated floralcy of Petalia. Majestic Akigalawood truly signs the fragrance. This exclusive natural ingredient is upcycled from Patchouli through a biotechnology process. Its unique spicy-woody character is enhanced by a rich Indonesian Patchouli oil and a powerful, sustainable note of Ambrofix. Eau de Parfum concentrated at 16% – Alcohol made of Beetroot – Without Coloring – 93% Natural – Unisex.

name: Bois Impérial Extrait
description: Perfumer: Quentin Bisch Explore the nocturnal side of Bois Impérial. Created as a quintessential version of the original fragrance, Bois Impérial Extrait takes you to the nocturnal side of the perfume. Darker, richer, stronger, it reveals a new sensuality and a rare intensity with twice the concentration of the Eau de Parfum. An absolute of seduction. Majestic Akigalawood truly signs the fragrance. This exclusive natural ingredient is upcycled from Patchouli through a biotechnology process. Its unique spicy-woody character is enhanced by a rich Indonesian Patchouli oil and a powerful, sustainable note of Ambrofix. A woody ambery nectar of rare intensity On the skin, the opening retains its irresistible sparkle. Black pepper electrifies timeout berry in an invigorating flight of spicy facets. Gradually, the floral heart settles in, revealing a new richness: rose absolute adds palpable density to the eau de parfum’s petal-like facets. Finally, Bois Impérial Extrait asserts its distinctiv

name: Borabora
description: Borabora by Giardini di Toscana is a real olfactory metaverse. With Borabora you feel projected into an explosion of flowers: Tiare, Ylang Ylang, Rose, Jasmine. This perfume drags you into a joyful dance, with Coconut and Vanilla providing intense emotions. Elegant musks and amber notes create an intriguing and seductive composition. Borabora screams "Hug me, hug me".

name: Brownie Pop
description: Brownie Pop captures the essence of a fudgy brownie topped with caramelized popcorn. Imagine yourself in a light-filled kitchen, where the rich aroma of caramelized brown sugar fills the air. The fragrance opens with the comforting sweetness of a soft, still-warm brownie, with chocolate chips gently melting on your tongue. Then, a swirl of caramelized popcorn joins the party, crunchy and sweet, adding a funfair note to this indulgent treat. Finally, creamy sandalwood and vanilla wrap it all up in a comforting warmth, like a sweet hug. Brownie Pop is much more than a fragrance, it's a gourmet escape into a world of irresistible sweets.

name: Bubble Forever
description: An enchanting fusion of fresh orange blossom and the sweetness of pear, evoking the scent of bubble gum. Indulgence unfolds in a gourmet symphony where vanilla, caramel, neroli, cinnamon, jasmine, rose, musk, and amber harmoniously blend, sculpting a pastel pink bubble of femininity.

name: Bukhara EDP
description: Bukhara, from the esteemed Route de la Soie collection, embodies a sense of lavish refinement. The tantalizing top notes of succulent peach and rich blackcurrant, conjuring images of an exotic oasis. At its heart, the fragrance exudes an entrancing bouquet of tuberose, jasmine absolute, and orange blossom, evoking a graceful floral allure. The dry down unfurls with a sensuous base of sandalwood, cedarwood, vanilla, and Oudh, enveloping the wearer in a warm embrace. Bukhara is an exquisite and indulgent scent, exceptionally good for those who desire the ultimate in life’s experiences.

name: Café Des Délices
description: A calm morning, a cup still steaming, a pastry barely opened... Café des Délices captures this suspended moment, between comfort and temptation. It all starts with a flight of sweet and creamy coffee, like a latte savoured in the light of day. The heat of the grain rounds out on contact with a golden, crispy, melting, almost caramelized biscuit. Then the vanilla slips in gently, wrapped in tonka with accents of praline and hazelnut. The whole thing rests on a cloud of velvety musk which prolongs the pleasure, like the scent of warm linen or beloved skin. Gourmand without excess, warm without heaviness , Café des Délices is a sweet interlude, a fragrance that comforts as much as it seduces. An olfactory madeleine to be enjoyed at any time.

name: Can’t Get Enough
description: An endless rush of desire that makes you feel fiercely alive. The essence of this craving? A scent. A scent of flesh and temptation. A Rose, shaken by Pink Pepper. The obsession spills over with a visceral, haunting gourmandise: shameless Caramel, voluptuous Vanilla, and planted right at the heart, Hedione—a spectral molecule that cloaks every note in unreasonable sensuality. CAN'T GET ENOUGH is a fragrance of obsession that keeps you coming back for more—again and again, and again. A hypnotic loop. An insatiable desire. A devouring passion. You crave this scent beyond reason, rejecting every ounce of restraint and ignoring all forms of moderation. True to its name, it is haunting, captivating, irresistible.

name: Casa Blanca
description: Philosophic – Impeccable – Smoky Experience an air of coastal Mediterranean sophistication. Enter a serene white temple nestled within a coastal field of fig trees and immerse yourself in Casa Blanca’s puriFIGating journey. Experience a fragrant atmosphere that inspires self-reflection and evokes a mindset of understated luxury. Casa Blanca (White House) is an ode to creative arts and effortless elegance, an olfactive representation of House of Bō’s signature DNA, rooted in simplicity, minimalism and spirituality.

name: Castley
description: Thanks to meticulously selected high-end ingredients, Castley expresses the perfect balance between luminous freshness and spicy energy, reflecting a vigorous man always on the move. Breezy citrusy and mineral notes contrast with rich spicy Timut Pepper, ambery Labdanum and noble Akigwalawood that unveil an intense side. A vibrant fragrance, embodying intrepidity and confidence, with a unique history, shaping the trail of a bold ascent.

name: Cedrat Boise
description: Vibrant and sparkling, Cedrat Boise opens with notes of citrus fruits, blackcurrants and spices and rests on a sensual heart of jasmine and patchouli leaves. Its long-lasting sillage captivates you with woody, vanilla, leathery and musky notes.

name: Ambre Du Reve
description: An oriental dream - Golden light and enveloping sweetness, bewitching. A unique and addictive character.

name: Caprice De Jeanne
description: This fragrance narrates the story of Jeanne, a woman of fearless character, influenced by her journeys in the Middle East and her sun-soaked summers in the Mediterranean. Caprice de Jeanne, a woody and fruity perfume, encapsulates the magical blend of rich Oriental traditions and the summery sweetness of cherry-picking moments in the South of France. Inspired by Jeanne's enigmatic personality, this Chabaud fragrance is a rich and intricate composition that captures her elusive charm.

name: Caprice De Julie
description: Caprice de Julie belongs to the series of the Caprice collection, dedicated to vibrant, joyful, and fruity notes, plenty of character, and sensuality. We have imagined Julie enjoying the freshness of nature, picking blueberries in the woods, rediscovering the Alps with Edelweiss, and tasting watermelon after a nice day outdoors. This eau de parfum is like a dive in the joy of nature, a hymn to the comfort and refreshment of the wild fruits from the woods, a spiritual journey that reconnects us with the magic of our planet and the ever-surprising richness of its fruits.

name: Caprice De Marie
description: An eau de parfum with the fruity scent of peach blending with blackcurrant, pineapple, and pear. A sparkling accord full of surprise, as the young Marie. The heart notes reveal the floral and sweet accent of lily of the valley and caramel. A combination of elegance and delicacy. Without forgetting the comfort and sweetness of vanilla that closes this essence with absolute perspectives.

name: Caprice De Sophie
description: Chabaud Caprice de Sophie expresses charm, euphoria and fantasy. A sparkling fragrance that combines a touch of mischief, sweetness, softness and sensuality.

name: Cedre Noble
description: A smoky and deep fragrance brings the magic and force of Lebanese cedar.

name: Chic Et Boheme
description: Chic Et Boheme by Chabaud Maison de Parfum brings together the beguiling and alluring power of the flowers and releases them full of optimism, charm, and personality again. An Eau de Parfum carries both a playful lightness and a wonderful spirit in itself.

name: Fleur De Figuier
description: Conjures up a picture of spring and summer on the Mediterranean and the powerful, unleashed green that gives life to nature by responding to this with timeless elegance, freshness and softness.

name: Ile Mythique
description: Ile Mythique by Chabaud Maison de Parfum is a mythical island of the Mediterranean Sea where many of us have dear memories. It could be Corsica, Ithaca in Greece, the Balearic islands, or again Sardinia. It is somehow the scent of a cherished island close to our hearts and soul.

name: Innocente Fragilite
description: The white flowers are immaculate married with white musk and thus yield a tribute to purity. A fragrance for the absolutely feminine woman, delicate and at the same time aware of the fragility of innocence.

name: La Nuit Danse
description: The delicacy of a powdery and sophisticated perfume - fragrance boudoir and other wonders hidden in the dressing table of a mysterious and infinitely sensual woman.

name: Lait Concentre
description: Lait Concentre by Chabaud Maison de Parfum evokes a childhood memory that is connected to the popular and delicious condensed milk. It is fairylike, like a transparent veil, which merges smoothly with the skin, like a fleeting memory that you can just hold on to with your fingertips - a delicious and ethereal eau de toilette.

name: Lait De Biscuit
description: Lait de Biscuit by Chabaud Maison de Parfum leads us in a flash back to our childhood - a delicious fragrance, reminiscent of cherished treats. A fateful blend of sweetness and mouthwatering delicacies. A wonderful eau de toilette that offers a journey through time and maximum enjoyment at the same time.

name: Lait De Vanille
description: Lait De Vanille by Chabaud Maison de Parfum is a gift full of sweetness, comfort, and recovered innocence which reminds us of inner peace and the sense of well-being, which a cup of hot milk, a butter cookie or the taste of vanilla gave us. An eau de toilette - delicious enough to eat - with the lightness of memories and self-confident.

name: Lait Et Chocolat
description: Lait Et Chocolat by Chabaud Maison de Parfum is a delicious fragrance that evokes emotions made of love and sensuality.

name: Lumiere De Venise
description: Lumiere De Venise by Chabaud Maison de Parfum is a tribute to the Serenissima, aeternal mirror of beauty and light. The beauty of this perfume relies upon the harmony of floral notes of jasmine and rose that evolve in a trail of wood notes, chypre and patchouli giving a unique and luxurious velvet touch.

name: Mysterious Oud
description: In "Mysterious Oud" the performers pass by in a hypnotic dreamlike procession, inspired and fulfilled by a mystery which they share with us. Mysterious Oud by Chabaud Maison de Parfum fragrance as mysterious as the cultures of distant lands, composed from secret recipes and supported by an unspeakable and magical harmony.

name: Nectar De Fleurs
description: Nectar De Fleurs by Chabaud Maison de Parfum. A soft bubble of freesia and neroli reveals at its core sweet violet, rose, ylang-ylang, and orange blossom, unfolding onto an exquisite base of warm Bourbon vanilla with captivating notes of white musk.

name: Orangerie Musicale
description: Orangerie Musicale by Chabaud Maison de Parfum is the atmosphere of French chateaux orange gardens which nowadays are often places for beautiful concerts, especially in the southern of France.

name: Patchouli 1973
description: Patchouli 1973 by Chabaud Maison de Parfum is the spirit of chic and wild from the early 70s, convertible cars, motorbikes, the freedom given by the quest for new discoveries and experiences.

name: Rose Orage
description: Rose Orage by Chabaud Maison De Parfum. This Eau de perfume recreates a whole day in the life of a rose with warm and cold shades typical of this unique flower. Orage means that subtle moment of change of temperature when the perfume of the rose changes from being warm under the sun and then refreshed by the rain.

name: Vert D'eau
description: Vert d'Eau by Chabaud Maison de Parfum is dedicated to the popular green tones of the fragrance universe that, like the colors themselves, are reminiscent of the resurrection of nature in spring and the power of new love. It lends with its balanced harmony a tangentially masculine touch - green, sparkling, and highly cultured.

name: Vintage
description: Vintage Fragrance by Chabaud Maison De Parfum is a fragrance that captures the magic of the good old days with their classic floral fragrances, reminiscent of sweet childhood days, though it still remains anchored in the here and now. A nostalgic yet modern fragrance with an exciting and gentle oriental accent.

name: Champaca Pure Parfum
description: Champaca is a tiny pale orange flower from India. Related to the magnolia and deemed sacred in the Indus Valley, Champaca flower absolute is a heavenly, creamy floral scent – both elegant & intimate. Blended with neroli and bamboo and underscored with fragrant rice and green tea notes, this is a distinguished perfume of rare beauty.

name: Chandigarh Express
description: Departure to utopia Mid-fifties, North of India, the Sivaliks, on the foothills of the Himalayan Mountains. From a vanguard vision will rise an ideal city: Chandigarh. Union between India and France where, alike bandmasters, visionary architects designed, ex nihilo,this modernist utopia in the midst of a tropical jungle. Perfumer: Gaël Montero

name: Cherry Cherry
description: Cherry Cherry captures the essence of opulent black cherry with a bold, unisex twist. Elevated by fresh bergamot and lush floral notes of iris and jasmine, it settles into a sensual trail of white musk and vanilla, leaving behind a luxurious and unforgettable signature.

name: Chimilka EDP
description: Vilhelm Parfumerie invites you to discover a noble woman made of fire. Between duty and desire, strength and passion, Chimilka is an ode to all women who transcend their femininity to express what they are made of. Strong, free, magnetic, Chimilka is a leader and an inspiration. Beyond femininity, she embodies the idea of freedom.

name: Choco Loco (Holiday Exclusive)
description: It’s a hot chocolate gone rogue. Triple-dosed, over-whipped, under-disciplined. Call it comfort. Call it madness. Call it sweet, dirty joy in a bottle.

name: Chocolate Greedy
description: Chocolate Greedy is a mouth-watering ode to delectable creaminess, a luscious, rich ganache of incredible scrumptiousness. The middle stage has an attractive hint of powderiness that makes us think of the highest-quality cocoa generously sprinkled on very expensive truffles with a subtle undertone of bitter orange. The chocolate creaminess turns the dry down of Chocolate Greedy into an exquisitely, subtly gourmand skin scent, delicate, enveloping and very sensual.

name: Christos EDP
description: Christos is a fragrance that follows no trend, only the rhythm within. It breathes of strength, depth, and awareness. A trail designed for those who seek fragrances rich in meaning, complex and authentic. A persistent, enveloping scent built around an ambery, resinous, and woody accord. The opening strikes immediately with the power of Amberxtreme, incense, and bergamot. The heart reveals its resinous, earthy soul with rose, patchouli, and labdanum cistus. The base is warm, potent, and mysterious: amber, vanilla, benzoin, sandalwood, pink pepper, and more incense close the composition with a profound, unforgettable trail.

name: Ciel Immobile
description: Ciel Immobile explores the green balsamic woody theme giving it a modern twist of spicy highlights only developed in the 21st century. Supposedly the formula has a Greek temple nuance (the mineral theme), lush green vegetation surrounding it and guess who will be the Greek god wearing it?

name: Cinque Terre
description: Cinque Terre is a fresh, unisex fragrance that evokes the salty breeze of Italy’s coastline. With bright citrus and herbal notes, it balances sunlit warmth and marine freshness, capturing the essence of Mediterranean elegance.

name: Colonia Nobile EDP
description: Colonia Nobile is the modern reinterpretation of the classic Italian cologne. Fresh, clean, and refi ned, it unites the timeless charm of citrus with the contemporary depth of musks and ambers. This unisex, refined, and persistent fragrance evolves with balance between luminosity, structure, and endurance. It opens with a vibrant burst of bergamot, petitgrain, and neroli. The floral-aromatic heart blends karismal, jasmine, and benzoin, offering rounded depth. In the base, ambrettolide, ambroxan, and oakmoss build an elegant, structured, and clean trail.

name: Coro EDP
description: Coro is a scent with an invigorating energy. Its vibe is that of an early riser, a go-getter who is ready to take on the world. Curtains drawn at dawn to bask in the glory of another new day, hikes to the summit and back before lunchtime. Its energising freshness is its defining feature, a result of its purposefully curated composition.

name: Cosmos
description: Smoky – Metallic – Decadent “A galactic haze of ambrosial smoke infused with cosmic mineral elements.” In cosmology, ‘æther’ is considered to be the 5th element. The omnipresent fabric of the universe in which all elements live in suspension. COSMOS is that celestial veil, where fire, ice, earth and air intertwine in chaotic harmony. A flash of cold, metallic minerals is heated and forged into molten sweetness, releasing notes of aged whiskey and praline. From this fusion, a smoky veil of dragon’s blood incense arises, evoking the sensation of smoke over ice. As the smoke clears, facets of leather, rich cacao, and mysterious agarwood emerge — revealing the secret duality of a fragrance that is both sophisticated and dangerously alluring. This is not just a scent — it is the magnetic presence of those who resist definition, moving through the world entirely on their own terms.

name: Coton Egyptien
description: Cotton flower and white musk... On the banks of the Nile Delta, the white gold of Egypt blooms. At the foot of the pyramids lie fields of cotton flowers, which in the setting sun seem to sparkle with white stars. Phaedon imagines the scent of the cedar sap that the cotton flower would have sucked and transformed into a floral vapor, of musk and aldehydes.

name: Crazy In Love
description: Inspired by the wondrous Kingdom of Montale emotions, this fragrance opens itself to mystery and wonder with wild roses, violet leaves, saffron and intense amber. Recalling the nostalgic goodness of brown sugar infused with the sensual warmth of a vanilla bean - that kind of «signature» scent that we love to create, will warm your soul. Rich with contrast, dreamlike in its serenity, Crazy in Love will brings you subtle energies and passion in your life. A Montale talisman full of luck.

name: Crème Ebene
description: Crème Ébène is an enchanting fragrance which blends the majestic strength of precious woods with the addictive sweetness of creamy notes highlighted by leather and spices. A bouquet of spices, cardamom, cumin and saffron weaves a captivating, mysterious aura that opens onto a woody soul anchored by the noble elegance of cedar. A note softened by the sweet, velvety generosity of Medjool dates and creamy vanilla provides roundness and subtlety. This Eau de Parfum Intense ultimately reveals a deeper, darker facet. A refined leather infused with papyrus essence with slightly smoky accents blends with the earthy richness of patchouli, the milky warmth of sandalwood and the sensual touch of white musk for an enveloping and seductive attire. A textured elegance, both opulent and intimate, like a warm breeze on bare skin.

name: Crimson Aura
description: Like the glow of a sun suspended in the cosmos, Crimson Aura surrounds you in a veil of warmth and sweetness that feels alive. It is not just a fragrance—it is an energy, a presence, an aura that radiates from within.

name: Cuir InfraRouge Extrait
description: Developed in collaboration with perfumer Jordi Fernandez, Cuir Infra Ro uge was inspired by the taste of a raspberry cocktail while attending an electronic music festival. Founder Thibaud Crivelli shares, “This creation is a delight: it sees an incredible contrast between a young, vibrant, luminous and nearly fluorescent raspberry accord on one side, and a deep, comforting and sophisticated leather accord on the other.” This vibrant contrast sets the tone from the very first notes, an invigorating blend of raspberry accord and fresh, juicy citruses. The heart sees cedarwood coupled with the powdery notes of orris & cinnamon, while osmanthus brings leather and apricot tones. The drydown is built on a beautiful combination of leather suede accord, oud and patchouli. Vanilla prolongs the elegance of the creation with its addictive and intoxicating warmth.

name: Damask EDP
description: An abstract creation of damascene rose shimmering with charm and elegance. Gourmande fruity notes of pear, lemon, blackcurrant and pink berries, forming a backdrop of unique character. Mineral amber and musk reveal inner depths of sophistication, guiding the scent into a beguiling and extraordinary perfume.

name: Dark Purple
description: Floral and luscious notes on a dark, earthy and opulent base of musk and patchouli envelop a top notes of plum and voluptuous roses. A sensual and bewitching fragrance that will seduce audacious minds.

name: Day Dreams
description: Reminiscing warm summer nights in Greece, where the daylight is endless. The air evokes the scent of Orange Blossom, Jasmine and Mandarin. The Neroli, the Tiare Flower and the Sandalwood awake the night into a surprising Vanilla - Coconut realm.

name: Decision
description: Starting with an olfactory bolt of lightning, Decision banishes the darkness of uncertainty – an effect achieved through a combination of the cool woodiness and citrus-mineralic sparkle of Frankincense, Bergamot, Myrrh and Juniper Berries. After this striking opening, the light spreads further, aided by the gleaming sheen of Atlas Cedarwood. Finally, a warm Vanilla in the base conveys the profoundly liberating effect of acceptance. Uncompromising, distinctive and incandescent, Decision captures the paradox that lies at the core of all of life’s most powerful decisions: it is focused on its goal while remaining open to countless possibilities. 33% oil concentration, 5 weeks ageing: 3 weeks maceration, 2 weeks maturation

name: Dialogue with Venus
description: THE INSPIRATION In 1977, the year I was born, Helmut Newton immortalized Charlotte Rampling in a series of photos entitled Venus in Fur . A feline and supersensual woman embodies sexual power: emancipated, she takes possession of her body and asserts her desires. Echoing the sexual revolution and its bohemian patchouli, the perfumery of the 70s distils a chic eroticism , all in suggestion, where heady white flowers pierced by green, powdery and aldehydic notes anchor the fragrances of this decade in a glamorous sophistication. THE PERFUME Dialogue with Venus opens with a white floral accord evoking the luxurious and exaggerated femininity of the 70’s, while its fruity, silky and solar vanilla is treated according to the codes of the House of PIERRE GUILLAUME PARIS. Subtle exotic sprays flow through this floral melody like a wind of freedom, suggesting a mischievous and sexy “je-ne-sais-quoi” , an effortless chic .

name: Dirty Heaven
description: Dirty heaven opens with a luminous burst of white flowers – jasmine and neroli, their sweetness amplified rather than tamed. Creamy tonka bean swirls into the heart, its almond-like richness infused with a hint of saffron spice, adding a touch of warmth. The base is where things get truly interesting: ambroxan, vanilla, and white musks create a cloud of sensual warmth, while grey amber and modern woods ground the sweetness with a subtle, animalic edge – it’s unexpected, but oh-so-addictive. Dirty heaven is for those who seek beauty laced with a touch of intrigue. Those who find the most captivating scents exist just on the edge of familiar, where the sweet and the subtly sinful intertwine. Wear it and embrace a fragrance that evokes a sense of mystery, a whisper of something deliciously out of reach.

name: Dirty Milk
description: DIRTY MILK starts with a splash of creamy milk and gooey caramel, cut through by a flash of black pepper. Sharp, hot, and just enough to make it dangerous. It’s the spark, the heat before the dirtiness. Then it softens: buttery iris blends into warm akigalawood, like skin meeting skin. The dry-down is slow and thick, with vanilla and musk sinking into the body like cream left on warm skin. Rich, sweet, and just on the edge of decadence. Still sweet. Still dirty. Right on the edge.

name: Dirty Rice
description: Raw seduction, refined. Dirty rice opens with a flash of brightness – bergamot and almond create a vibrant, attention-grabbing accord. Yet, there’s a playful warmth that hints at the complexity to come. The heart of the fragrance reveals a dominant basmati rice note. Its warm, starchy sweetness is grounded by a subtle touch of earthiness, creating a unique, skin-like quality. Peony and milk provide a delicate counterpoint, adding a touch of floral sweetness and creaminess that flirts with innocence. The base is a study in contrasts: smoky sandalwood and vetiver provide a classic, woody foundation, while the animalic whisper of musk adds depth and raw sensuality. Cetalox brings a velvety, skin-like warmth, amplifying the intimate feel of the fragrance and ensuring a lingering, addictive trail. Dirty rice isn’t just a scent, it’s an ode to intimacy. It’s for those who understand the beauty in stolen moments, the power in a gentle touch. This fragrance whispers of hushed confessions and s

name: Divine Vanille
description: Perfumer: Olivier Pescheux Divine Vanille is a tribute to Vanilla absolute, sustainably produced of Madagascar. Mysterious, suave, deep, carnal … simply irresistible. Natural Tonka Bean and benzoin enhance the soft, balmy, and addictive facets of Vanilla. A blend of natural Cinnamon bark and sensual leathery tones of natural Osmanthus reveal rich facets of blond Tobacco and dried fruits. An innovative fraction of natural Cedarwood and Patchouli brings a creamy woody structure highlighted with silky musks, wrapping the fragrance with a delicate luminous veil. Eau de Parfum concentrated at 16% – Alcohol made of Beetroot – Without Coloring – 89% Natural – Unisex.

name: Drunk Lovers
description: Drunk lovers explodes with a vibrant citrus rush – citronella, bergamot, and grapefruit dance with a hint of juniper and red berries, a burst of energy that sets the stage for the decadent heart. Brandy seeps into the scent, rich and boozy, mingling with a pulse of warm spices – ginger, pepper, and clary sage. The base is a whirlwind of sensual warmth: amber, sandalwood, and vanilla create a velvety richness, while benzoin resin, patchouli, and vetiver add an earthy depth that lingers on the skin. Cinnamon and musk add a final touch of animalic heat, a reminder of the wildness that lies beneath the surface. Drunk lovers is for those who embrace life’s wild side, who crave a fragrance as intoxicating and unpredictable as the night itself. Wear it and feel the rush of desire, the thrill of a love that consumes you, body and soul.

name: Drunk Saffron
description: Drunk saffron opens with a decadent burst of velvety plum, dipped in the warmth of fine cognac. The heart blooms with the intoxicating aroma of saffron – rich, heady, and tinged with a luxurious sweetness. A touch of supple leather and a hint of dark, roasted coffee add a sophisticated edge. The fragrance settles into a warm, sensual base of patchouli, creamy vanilla, and musk, leaving a lingering trail of extravagant pleasure. This is a fragrance for those who savor life’s illicit pleasures. This scent whispers of secrets, stolen moments, and the kind of pleasure that leaves you with a mischievous grin. Wear it, and let the night take you wherever it wants to go.

name: Elle Anniversary Perfume
description: Created as a tribute to the very first Xerjoff perfume, Elle Anniversary maintains the floral charm and sophistication of the original Elle fragrance, while caressing the wearer with a sweet, youthful touch. Its flacon is bestowed with a mother of pearl stone, which is said to have a divine feminine energy that nourishes the soul. A fitting adornment for a fragrance with so many deliciously gourmand notes.

name: Clean Suede (formerly Tom of Finland) EDP
description: The water slips over him as if sliding down a marble rock, sinking into the grooves of his muscles, vanishing into his pores. This is fresh, pure water, with top notes of aldehydes and lemon, a water that washes away the sins of the night and leaves the skin luminous. ​ He feels clean, like a shaving from a cake of soap. It is an ode to the beauty of the male body and to the radiance of the natural self. This perfume offers unrestricted access to the immense outdoors, the forest, with notes of birch leaves, cypress, galbanum, and pine at its heart. ​ He is sex, in all its fullness and magnitude, open and erect. Fantasy clings to him like his leather jacket, with suede, musk, and grey amber in the base notes. His belt is fastened with an accord of pepper and spicy-fresh saffron, tangled with a blond suede sensuality on a vanilla bed of tonka bean and iris. ​ This is a man who wants to play, love, to die and be reborn, again and again. This fragrance is a tribute to tomorrow’s glorious p

name: Exit The King EDP
description: NOTHING CAN RULE US The fall of the Kings is the fall of all the forces that oppress us and prevent us from moving forward. For a King to fall, an infinite number of little kingdoms must collapse: Family, Time, Love, Work, Toxicex-lovers, the Patriarchy, the obligations to be sad, Capital, the obligation to be happy, anguish, sex, and everything else that alienates us and prevents us from being truly free. This is about making a perfume like a Loire castle, a perfume that could rise higher than the castle of Bloise, higher than the terrace where the last Valois watched the sunset in its glory. And then disappear, die, as if by magic before the fall. The fall of certainties, but above all, the fall of power.

name: Fat Electrician EDP
description: LOVE FOR SALE, MEMORIES OF YOUTH, MORTALITY. His beauty would have been his greatest asset. One imagines he was raised in the big air of Texas, his soft skin scrubbed by ears of wheat, his eyelashes curled by grappling with grace against a blinding sun. A Midnight Cowboy lost on city asphalt. A fisherman without a line, he was made to be hooked by others, to believe in his fate without knowing it, to wreak havoc and forget it over time. Youth for women-of-a-certain-age, stock for late-night parties, a partner to accompany the wealthy of Palm Beach on nature walks, his splendor is consumed in the service of others.

name: Hermann EDP
description: Who goes beside you into the forest on the darkest night? In Victor Hugo’s poem, « À quoi songeaient les deux cavaliers dans la forêt », (What Two Horsemen Were Thinking in the Forest), the narrator says “ by my side, Hermann seemed to me like a shadow." We all have shadows, even at night in the dark forest. Hermman a Mes Cotes is the fragrance dedicated to your shadow. “The Alternative Self” that fills you with darkness, regrets, and misfortune but also with a sense of continuity and peace. To capture this duality of the self and the shadow, Hermann opens with cold, aromatic top notes met by the mist of peppery rose and an earthy dry down of dark woods, incense, and patchouli. The entire composition remains sheer throughout, enabling light to cast a shadow on your skin.

name: I Am Trash EDP
description: THE MOST WANTED SCENT MADE FROM THE UNWANTED Alternative fragrance power-house Etat Libre d'Orange has partnered with the leading fragrance manufacturer, Givaudan, and the award-winning creative network, Ogilvy, for a revolutionary new fragrance launch: that sets a new relationship between waste and luxury, a gratitude for our beloved planet. I Am Trash is predominantly made of ingredients that have already been distilled (for other perfumes or products) and would normally be discarded. However, with the groundbreaking process of upcycling, the ingredients are now being distilled for a second-time, for a new life. The result is brand new facets of reused ingredients that bring together the most wanted scent from the most unwanted ingredients. Six of the ingredients of Etat Libre D’Orange I Am Trash are upcycled, most notably the Apple Oil (derived from fruit waste of the juice industry, destined to become animal feed), the Rose NeoAbsolute (extracted from apparently exhausted rose peta

name: Remarkable People EDP
description: FOR EVERY EPOCH, FOR EVERY ERA, THERE ARE REMARKABLE PEOPLE In classical mythologies, there were the demigods, the offspring of a god and a human, or a mortal who was raised to divine status. An ancient Greek poet used the word demigod as a synonym for hero. They demonstrated strength and power, a willingness to face challenges and confront danger. In the New World, there were explorers, who discovered unknown lands. They were heroes too, battling forces of nature to find new territories. Throughout history — scientists, artists, composers, and entertainers — have all heroes in their way. New heroes are born every day. There is an element, an event, a circumstance, or maybe just a quirk in their personalities that changes them empowers them, and enables them to transcend the ordinary. They believe in something different, something better. They want to change the rules, break the rules, and alter the status quo, in whatever grand or small way they find meaningful. They are on a journey,

name: She Was An Anomaly EDP
description: FOR THE ONE YOU WILL NEVER UNDERSTAND Ever since its inception, Etat Libre d’Orange has been an oddity, a deviation from the norm, an eccentric in the world of perfumery, an anomaly; different from what is usual. This fragrance is inspired and dedicated to Nina Simone (American singer, songwriter, musician, arranger and civil rights activist) and Stanley Kubrick (an American film director, screenwriter and producer who is frequently cited as one of the greatest and most influential filmmakers in cinematic history) to celebrate their talents, their deviations from the norm, from the theoretical value, from the expected.

name: You or Someone Like You EDP
description: COOL, CRISP, DREAMER, HOLLYWOOD, EXPOSED You or Someone Like You is a contemporary creation built around timeless materials. It embodies the women of LA – someone like Anne Rosenbaum: cool and crisp; once foreign but now indigenous; very exposed to Hollywood’s silver screen dreams yet untouched by its materialistic machinery. Anne finds comfort in literature, and the garden of her home which nestles in the hills overlooking downtown LA. Does Los Angeles have a scent? It’s impossible to say. But Chandler Burr knows Los Angeles. And Chandler Burr knows perfume. So we decided to collaborate on a fragrance that an LA woman might wear. And we gave it the name of Chandler’s novel, set in Los Angeles. The perfume invigorates the senses with its fresh, inviting appeal. One feels good wearing it. You may be clever or naïve, innocent or sophisticated, sexy or chaste, curvy or thin, tall/small, sweet/dangerous; you may be blonde, brunette, redhead, bald, or coiffed in some interesting blend of pr

name: Evasion Bonbon
description: Evasion Bonbon is that candy that takes you right back to childhood, the one that makes you smile as soon as you smell it. From the very first notes, a sweet, melting wave envelops you, like a comforting candy that melts delicately in your mouth. Powerful, indulgent and gentle, it transports you to simple, happy memories. A perfect escape, full of tenderness, like a sweet treat you can't help but love.

name: Existence EDP
description: An expression of the serenity of endlessness, Existence is based around a heart-breaking note of Lily of the Valley. Delicate and fragile, it is also possessed of a remarkable expansiveness, thanks to the addition of Frankincense. As the scent develops, an Aldehyde facet enhances the impression of pristine whiteness, while Rose adds living, breathing physicality. In the base, Benzoin connects the landscape to the complex reality of the earth. Bright, sincere and emotive, Existence conveys the incomprehensible vastness of the infinite, with all of its life-affirming optimism. The nose behind this fragrance is Quentin Bisch. 20% oil concentration, 4 weeks ageing: 2 weeks maceration, 2 weeks maturation

name: Extrait Blue Talisman
description: A hypnotic jewel Just like its original signature, BLUE TALISMAN Extrait has been designed as an immersive journey into a precious jewel and invites you to lose yourself into a kaleidoscope of sensations. Bewitching and multifaceted, this creation embodies the House’s Avant-Garde spirit through its ultimate version. Perfumer: Jordi Fernández

name: Extrait Fleur Narcotique
description: Floral overdose FLEUR NARCOTIQUE, the iconic creation by French perfumer Quentin Bisch, re-invents itself through a quintessential essence. The extrait de parfum expresses the most sophisticated and intense personality as seen by Quentin. Perfumer: Quentin Bisch

name: Extrait Lust in Paradise
description: French Riviera addiction Elevating the original olfactory signature to its quintessence, LUST IN PARADISE Extrait de parfum is a radiant creation, bathed in the glow of the French Riviera sunset. Perfumer: Louise Turner

name: Fan Your Flames
description: Depicts a lovely night-out with the company of loved ones smoking shisha with coconut, enjoying the nice chat, anticipating better days to come! Enjoy the good moods to celebrate life! "Set your life on fire and seek those who fan your flames" -Rumi

name: Fig Infusion
description: Perfumer: Nathalie Lorson Inspired by the light of a sunny day in the south of France, Nathalie Lorson has composed an optimistic and reassuring fragrance. The top note, a larger-than-life fig, is illuminated by a duo of juicy citrus mandarin and clementine. The floral heart, composed of freesia and orange blossom, meets the aromatic breath of Sri Lankan black tea. Finally, an enveloping wood accord, between the softness of Virginian cedarwood and the creaminess of sandalwood, provides comfort and refinement to the signature. The voluptuous benzoin reinforces this cocooning accord with its balmy effects. Eau de Parfum concentrated at 17% – Alcohol made of Beetroot – Without Coloring – 92% Natural – Unisex.

name: Fig Me Up
description: Fig Me Up is your ultimate "cheer me up." Bright fig leaves and zesty rhubarb instantly elevate your mood, while creamy woods wrap you in a luxurious embrace. A warm, addictive finish lingers, leaving an unforgettable, irresistible trail. Unisex, bold, uplifting.

name: Fig Porn
description: Fig porn opens with the juicy sweetness of a ripe fig, so full of nectar it feels like it will burst. A touch of pear adds a playful sweetness, while a burst of zesty bergamot keeps it fresh. The fragrance melts into lush peony and velvety turkish rose – rich, almost overpowering, like an intense rush of emotion - like the touch of a lover’s hand. A hint of creamy milk and soft powder provides a comforting warmth. Warm vanilla and rich amber create a sensual base, pulsing with a subtle heat. Powdery sandalwood adds a final hint of intimacy, like the soft touch of skin after a passionate moment. Fig porn is for those ready to lose themselves in love. A scent that starts sweet, then blooms with an intoxicating depth that hints at something wild. Imagine a grounding, sensual warmth smoldering beneath, promising a lingering heat. This scent is a promise – reckless, thrilling, a taste of love in its most potent, untamed form.

name: Filthy Musk
description: A sweet tease of pineapple and honey opens the fragrance, but don’t let it fool you—this is just the calm before the storm. Enter musk—raw, carnal, and primal. Nutmeg’s warmth and Patchouli’s earthy richness push the scent into the untamed wild. Jasmine flirts with spice, amplifying the intoxicatingly dirty allure. Then comes vanilla and caramel, but not the soft, innocent kind. This is a dark, seductive sweetness, entangled with the musk’s raw energy. A sexual growl of civet laces the base, while amber and tonka bean leave a trail that lingers long after you‘ve left the room. The final impression? Dirty, dirty, and dirty. This is musk at its most primal state.

name: Fleur Narcotique
description: FLEUR NARCOTIQUE is a symphony of sensuality, capturing the Parisian essence of EX NIHILO. Lush florals intertwine with seductive woods, creating an intoxicating embrace. Each note reveals a sophisticated allure, blending boldness with elegance. An aromatic journey at the edge of transgression, leaving an unforgettable trail. Perfumer: Quentin Bisch

name: Florentine Diamond
description: women and men. This is a new fragrance. Florentine Diamond was launched in 2025. Top notes are Mandarin and Cocoa; middle notes are Sugar Cane, Tuberose and Barley; base notes are Vanilla, Oak and Oud. Florentine Diamond by Thameen is an alluring fragrance that combines intoxicating tuberose with rich cocoa undertones. The composition reveals woody notes and the essence of sugar cane, while oud and vanilla provide a lingering, sophisticated finish. The Florentine Diamond is a lost diamond of Indian origin from the 16th century. It was cut in the form of an irregular nine-sided 126 facet double rose cut with a weight of 137 carats.

name: Galaxia
description: To drift through the Milky Way is to be suspended in light—soft, infinite, quietly radiant. Galaxia captures that sensation with a luminous lactonic glow, smooth and enveloping like starlight scattered across endless space.

name: Celeste EDP
description: It is the bright and crystalline dawn after a nocturnal storm, the air is fresh and the sky expands in its celestial and clean perfection. The fragrances spread powerful and overbearing: delicately citrus fresh notes, clean with a floral touch of violet iris.

name: Gold Immortals
description: Infinite floriental GOLD IMMORTALS elevates Oriental traditions with a daring Haute Couture twist. This mystical elixir transports you to a dreamlike paradise, inspired by the quest for immortality. Its opulent and timeless blend captivates the senses, making it a fragrance of extraordinary elegance. Perfumer: Jordi Fernández

name: Bohemian Lime
description: TROPICAL & FREE SPIRITED Set beneath a sunlit canopy of lush tropical rainforest, the scent evokes an image of native citrus trees drawing life from nearby cascading fresh waterfalls. With its invigorating opening of Australian finger lime and coriander, Bohemian Lime mellows to reveal blissful grounding notes of vetiver, cedar wood and sandalwood. Bohemian Lime is a carefree fragrance for women and men, and an ode to Byron bay, Australia’s premier free-spirited tropical enclave and the place where the country first meets the sun.

name: Ingenious Ginger
description: Transportive and Seductive, Ingenious Ginger offers an instant sense of nature in a blissful and sultry destination. A solar perfume of sun-kissed mandarin, spicy ginger, elegant white florals, and warm, enveloping amber that cascades across your skin. An olfactory imagining of the unscented torch ginger lily flower, Ingenious Ginger is an abstract citrusy, floral, and ambery perfume that expresses our Founder’s most beloved tropical flower, which grows in abundance at his holiday home in the wet tropics. This uplifting perfume opens with a burst of bergamot, amplified by the effervescent scent of ginger, the sparkle of mandarin, and the bright and sunny aura of magnolia.

name: Pacific Rock Moss
description: AQUATIC & ICONIC Seize the day and experience a moment of pure bliss with this aquatic and fresh perfume. A distinctive marine note graced with aromatic essences brings you on a lush coastal walk on a perfect summer day. Cedar wood gives this perfume a sturdy base on which to reveal a fresh, sea spray scent that speaks of summer days diving into Australia's blue waters. A fragrance for men and women, inspired by waves crashing upon sun-kissed rocks and long days that turn into warm summer nights.

name: Purple Suede
description: AROMATIC & LEATHERY Tasmanian lavender – a French affair. Born of Provence lavender introduced to Tasmania’s rich climate a century ago, purple suede expresses the scent of aromatic fields of sunburned lavender, where blossoms are crisped by the fierce heat of the sun. Paired with the scent of rust-colored saddles, this sensual perfume reveals a distinctively rich and dry sillage.

name: Silky Woods Elixir
description: Dark and excessive, Silky Woods Elixir is a smoky reawakening of the Australian agarwood originally used in Silky Woods eau de parfum. This exotic botanical is one of the most mysterious and revered essences in perfumery. Meticulously crafted with fig, saffron, orris, and syrupy balsam to reveal both the complex heart of agarwood and its verdant foliage, this woody and gourmand perfume is rich with luxurious intensity and sensuality. Perfumer: Olivier Cresp & Hamid Merati Kashani

name: Silky Woods
description: ORIENTAL & LUXURIOUS A more subtle, luxe, and modern interpretation of agarwood –one that is delightful to wear on any occasion and which offers the sensation of a distinctive woody fragrance on silk-smooth skin. Silky woods is delicate yet sensual and to enhance its oriental sillage of agarwood, suede, exotic vanilla, and smokey tobacco leaves, Goldfield & Banks adds to the perfume, saffron, incense, ylang-ylang, and Australian sandalwood.

name: Sunset Hour
description: JUICY & DELICIOUS As a blazing sun dips into the Indian ocean, the scent of fragrant native fruits pervades the languorous evening breeze. A heavenly cocktail of citrus and spicy delights awaits, giving way to a deliciously gourmand and sensuous floral heart. Best served at sunset hour!

name: Wood Infusion
description: WOODY & PROFOUND A luxe profound scent surrounded by an elixir of rich woods, buttery roots and aromatic notes. Inspired by the lush nature of the balmy heritage-listed Fraser Island in the Pacific Ocean, wood infusion is a celebration of all wood species found on the island. This fragrance is an exotic infusion of Australian woods enriched with Australian sandalwood, iris, and velvety agarwood (oud wood). This unique combination offers men and women the chance to wear a creamy and rich scent crafted from nature’s most noble botanicals.

name: Great Lord EDP
description: A timeless promise of emancipation. An attractive feeling of mystery. Between past and future, between power and secret, the golden path is an invitation to daring experiments. With the Great Lord, Vilhelm invites you to follow your destiny: write your story, elevate your life and reveal your sacred fire. Doubts are part of the path. Just dare.

name: Gris Charnel Extrait
description: Concentrated at 30%, Gris Charnel Extrait reveals the intensity of the original signature to extract a richer and more faceted version. A new creation, where the woody essence of patchouli is invited and brings depth to the sandalwood and tonka bean that reveal themselves more textured and warm. Voluptuous, vanilla underlines this trail with an ambery and smoked roundness. At the top, the freshness and vibrant cardamom combines with the delicacy of a fig with green and fruity accents. A bright opening that illuminates the opulent note of the fragrance. "Gris Charnel Extrait magnifies for me this Parisian sensuality already present in Gris Charnel. Parisian sensuality is expressed in many ways. I find it fascinating to be able to imagine all forms of sensuality through the eyes of Parisians. Everyone has their own definition and lives it with a fascinating freedom" David Benedek

name: Hibiscus Mahajad Extrait
description: Marble maze, a colorful haze. Ruby rose, hibiscus tea. Crushed pomegranate, sapphire blackcurrant. Cristal clear mint, shimmering cinnamon. Black gold and vanilla orchid. Sensual amber, carved leather. Inspiration: Tasting an infusion of hibiscus in the heart of a gemstone market. Contrast: The luminosity of a hibiscus/rose floral duo and the softness of vanilla bean. Perfumer: Quentin Bisch

name: Impadia
description: Inspired by the duality of an urban landscape and the symphony of colors that envelop it during sunrise and sunset, Impadia takes inspiration from shades of pink and orange, and from the intersection between a cityscape and the beautiful splashes of nature that come alive within it each spring. The resulting scent, created by perfumer Jordi Fernandez, is a luxurious floral, gourmand, and woody masterpiece with notes of Bulgarian and Turkish roses, Madagascar vanilla, and an addictive toffee accord.

name: Indecent Cherry
description: Cherries with an attitude. Indecent cherry opens with a sugar rush of cherry and a playful hint of almond, the perfect flirty facade. But then, the scent reveals its true colors: tart sour cherry and sassy strawberry add a delicious bite, while rose and mimosa lend an air of “who, me?” sophistication. Just when you think you’ve got it figured out, the base hits: musk, patchouli, and benzoin twist the sweetness into something decidedly grown-up. Think of it as the fragrance version of slipping a nip of bourbon into your cherry milkshake. Wear it if: you’re the one who always gets away with it. You’ve mastered the art of being both charming and a little bit dangerous. Indecent cherry is your signature scent – because life’s more fun with a touch of mischievous sweetness.

name: Ingenious Ginger Gift Set
description: We are excited to announce that the best-selling fragrance from Goldfield & Banks Australia, Ingenious Ginger , is now available in a deluxe coffret presentation the same price as the regular 100ml . This beautiful box set contains a 100ml bottle of Ingenious Ginger + a 10ml travel spray of Ingenious Ginger . This is a fantastic option to buy Ingenious Ginger in the 100ml size and get the travel spray for free.

name: Absolute Aphrodisiac
description: The softness of Vanilla is intimately intertwined with the animal potency of Musk and Castoreum. A powerful fragrance that obsessively reminds you of the other. A truly aphrodisiac essence.

name: Atomic Rose
description: A rose diffracted into a scent of phenomenal power. An olfactory explosion with an intense emotional charge. An exhilaration of pure energy, climaxing into intoxication. An extraordinary fragrance in the true sense of the word. From the first moment, rose rushes to the head and brings colour to the cheeks. As explosive as it is elusive, it expresses itself forcefully and fully embraces its ambiguities. Bright, with its shadows. Feminine and masculine. Soft, but ruthless.

name: Blessed Baraka
description: A solar fragrance endowed with a sacred strength to provoke the hand of fate. A captivating blend of Musk, Sandalwood, and Amber. Intangible energy surrounds the wearer. Its effect oscillates between pure power and pure addiction.

name: Musk Therapy
description: Close your eyes, Smell and feel a new way of sensations, Experience the power of scent therapy. Natural white sandalwood blended with an overdose of white and pink musk creates an ultra-addictive milky and velvety accord. The white magnolia activates the pleasure receptor while the cassis stimulates the energy, releasing a supplement of eroticism. MUSK THERAPY, a magical mood enhancer, paves the way to relaxation and a state of well-being. Finally, a delightful alternative to artificial paradises and their illicit substances.

name: Narcotic Delight
description: A Sensual Shot of Provocation It set its sights on the erogenous VANILLA BEAN , electrified by PINK PEPPER , drenched in a draught of COGNAC , before finally succumbing to the intoxicating swirls of a cigar. A cheeky twist of plump and juicy CHERRY celebrates the indulgence of a polished proposition.

name: Oud For Greatness
description: Oud for Greatness breathes out a force of nature, the wake of Greatness. The natural essence of Oud Wood has been perfected to this pitch, handled with majesty (and brutality) in this bold formula, scarcely highlighted by Patchouli and Musk. Superbly textured, and strikingly natural, Oud has been handled by the creator in an astonishingly fresh register (Lavender) and spicy (Nutmeg, Saffron). An enchanting, thrilling perfume that makes all our dreams of greatness possible.

name: Paragon
description: Paragon, goes beyond the skin to the soul and leads you to another dimension: plenitude. PARAGON houses the botanical soul of Palo Santo and White Sage. It draws in the beneficial properties of these sacred plants, whose use has been secretly passed down through initiation ceremonies dating back to the first lines of Inca shamans. This mystical blend holds both protective and purifying powers. It feeds self-confidence and helps the spirit to rise, enveloped in positivity.

name: Psychedelic Love
description: The signature of this narcotic bomb lies in three essential ingredients: Rose, Hedione and Heliotropin. Equally tender and illicit, this crystalline powder hides its intentions well. Beware of its creamy, powdery and floral facets, wavering between Vanilla and Almond!

name: Rehab
description: Rehab promises an ecstatic return to the pleasure of perfume. The harmony of its natural raw materials is revealed by a skilful combination of Bergamot, natural Lavender, Black Pepper & various Spices. It reaches an ultimate balance by lying on a bed of natural Sandalwood and Musk perfecting a modern fougère olfactory experience.

name: Side Effect
description: The Tobacco, Vanilla, Rum, and Cinnamon harmony of this fragrance is spellbinding. It tantalises the most discerning senses by playing off each of its facets - Leather, animal, and the woody note of Vanilla - one by one. Recklessly bold... and stirring. Deeply buried emotions and passions take over. The fragrance lifts the veil on the unsayable. This passionate perfume has the power to plunge its wearer into that altered state nothing is too daring because there are no risks left.

name: Instant Crush
