Seminalis floats in a glass flask with a tumbled silver metal cap and a drop of semitransparent bakelite. Labelled by ‘Savile row tweed paper’ with a ver

name: Stercus
description: STERCUS COMES FROM LATIN MEANING ‘FECES’. Once asked: “What is your favorite smell?”, the answer is always: “The smell of my own truth which might be a lie.” Feces never lie. They are the consistent indicators of health, a part of the essential body functioning, and a natural way to fertilize the soil. Stercus is honest, an honest indicator of quality. It is the secret sweetness that attracts, and the animalic side that offends. A sign of an infinite life circle. The smell of an end and the beginning. PACKAGING LEADS TO EXPLORE MORE All Orto Parisi fragrances are hidden in a box that opens up into a metropolis and reveals an infinite hole in the center. Stercus floats in a glass flask with a tumbled bronze metal cap with an inlaid brown horn. Labelled by ‘savile row tweed paper’ with a very fine herringbone structure.

name: Terroni
description: THE ROOTS PLAY A STRONG PART IN THE GROWTH AND DEVELOPMENT OF A CHARACTER. The World began with an explosion. The terrain was created by a burning volcanic lava swallowing the surface underneath. There’s something powerful and fulfilling about putting your hands in the soil, the sense of belonging to Earth. In order to develop a natural beauty, one needs to bind with traditions and grow strong roots to maintain the true light of the Self. PACKAGING LEADS TO EXPLORE MORE All Orto Parisi fragrances are hidden in a box that opens up into a metropolis and reveals an infinite hole at the center. Terroni floats in a glass flask with a tumbled gun metal cap with an inlaid volcanic stone. Labelled by ‘savile row tweed paper’ with a very fine herringbone structure.

name: Viride
description: VIRIDE COMES FROM LATIN MEANING ‘GREEN’. The most virile side of a man is always feminine. Viride has a very strong green character. A character of Yemeni man, who wears his traditional floral crown made of rosemary, sage and thyme. It is a scent that represents a garden that has been planted, fertilized and cultivated. A garden of knowledge based on experience. Viride is green, dark and strong royal green. From the deepest and strongest roots of herbal plants, the only way is up now. PACKAGING LEADS TO EXPLORE MORE All Orto Parisi fragrances are hidden in a box that opens up into a metropolis and reveals an infinite hole of the center. Viride floats in a glass flask with a tumbled gold metal cap with an inlaid lignum verde. Labelled by ‘savile row tweed paper’ with a very fine herringbone structure.

name: Oud Candy Extrait Extrême
description: Oud Candy opens with the rich sweetness of melting brown sugar, creamy nuts, and warm milk, creating a cocoon of indulgence. As the scent evolves, soft white florals bring a touch of refinement. The base reveals its darker side, with smoky oud, saffron, and black woods layered over velvety caramel and vanilla. Hints of leather and oakmoss add a sultry, bold finish. Sweet yet smoky, comforting yet daring - Oud Candy is a deliciously addictive journey into the dark side of indulgence.

name: Oud Maracuja Extrait
description: Best Niche Fragrance 2024 – Fragrantica Awards Getaway: maracujá sun, crocodile heat, amber mangroves, fading light. Stop: a copper -colored hut, rambutan rose , vanilla darkness. A fiery , woody ritual! Oud passion . A passion fruit tasting in remote oud wood forests. The surprising contrast: the richness of oud wood, contrasted by exotic and luminous passion fruit notes. Fragrance family: exotic, woody and fruity (vegan). In collaboration with perfumer: Jordi Fernandez

name: Oud Stallion Extrait
description: Oud Stallion was inspired by personal memories of Thibaud Crivelli, during which he smelled oud wood while attending horse races. From the grandstands, you can feel that the horses and the jockeys are in perfect symbiosis, and you are captivated by the energy and excitement of the crowd - which is unlike anything else. This perfume extract sees the depth of oud wood contrast with a smoky leather accord, illuminated with a vibrant and spicy facet of cardamom, saffron, and nutmeg. A floral and bright accord of rose, geranium, and osmanthus, heightened by a beautiful combination of tonka bean and leather, gives Oud Stallion its sensual character and long-lastingness. Fragrance family : A smoky leather oud fragrance.

name: Oudmazing
description: An amazing Aoud from Malaysia, audaciously blended with Orange and Bergamot, sweetened by mouth-watering Pear and Fig, unveils a sensual combination of Iris, Jasmine and Patchouli, and warms the skin with rich Leather notes, Vanilla, Pink Grape and White Musk.

name: Outcast Blue
description: For punks and poets OUTCAST BLUE channels the rebellious energy of a new generation of artists. Its vibrant scent bursts with bold creativity, like the blue signature of EX NIHILO. Inspired by a community of free spirits around EX NIHILO creators, this fragrance exudes daring confidence and unbridled artistic freedom. Perfumer: Jordi Fernández

name: Outlands
description: Outlands by Cécile Zarokian The edge of imagination. Uncharted mysteries . A dance with the unknown . Outlands is an invitation to journey into the beyond . The opening note of the composition is unexpectedly light-hearted: a n invigorating array of bright citruses, emphasised by zesty lemon. However, as the voyage continues, the landscape becomes more remote and more extraordinary. A rich, multi-faceted patchouli – projecting heat, humidity and verdancy in equal measure – compels the intrepid traveller to move deeper into the cryptic landscape. Finally, an amber accord – reverberating with the potency of balsams and resins – entices a progression to the ultimate encounter, where we find ourselves reflected and remade. As indescribable as it is familiar, Outlands makes use of extraordinary contrasts between light and shade to capture the ever-shifting inevitability of the future. The Amouage Essences An olfactory expression of the value of time. Crafted through a revolutionary process:

name: Pacific Rock Flower
description: Pacific Rock Flower joins the brand’s Native Collection and continues the story of the brand’s best-selling Pacific Rock Moss. Fresh, creamy, and wholly captivating, Pacific Rock Flower is a floral aquatic perfume created by perfumer Emilie Bouge, paying tribute to the white coastal tea tree flower. The bottle is also incredibly eye-catching, with a gradient of pale pink to oceanic blue. The resulting fragrance is one perfect for the Spring and Summer seasons!

name: Pacific Rock Moss Gift Set
description: We are excited to announce that the best-selling fragrance from Goldfield & Banks Australia, Pacific Rock Moss, is now available in a deluxe coffret presentation the same price as the regular 100ml . This beautiful box set contains a 100ml bottle + a 10ml travel spray of Pacific Rock Moss . This is a fantastic option to buy Ingenious Ginger in the 100ml size and get the travel spray for free.

name: Palatine
description: This empowering, yet sophisticated Eau de Parfum revolves around a modern floral bouquet enhanced with fresh, fruity and powdery notes. An opening of mandarin, bergamot and pear leads to a daring, contemporary violet petal. For a velvety sensation, the overall fragrance settles on musk and creamy sandalwood. Palatine encourages confidence, instilling a feeling of assertiveness, and freedom.

name: Papyrus Moléculaire EDP
description: Papyrus twist, carrot twirl, indigo grip. Incandescent roots, coriander boost, ground amyris. Strong character, powdery skin, peppery tonka. A hint of cigar: rebellious sweetness, pearls of laughter. Inspiration: The discovery of papyrus root powder, with women smoking cigarillos. Contrast: The surprising association of a woody powder and tobacco leaves. Perfumer: Leslie Girard (Robertet)

name: Althair
description: "An unexpected, modern ode to a universal ingredient in perfumery, which the House selected in the most natural, traditional, and noble quality available: Bourbon vanilla, a direct descendant of the vanilla introduced in France under the reign of Louis XV. A pronounced contrast between warm ingredients and a sensation of freshness; an interplay of affinities and dissimilarities; a blend of high perfumery’s traditional notes and disruptive molecules: Althaïr cultivates both distinctiveness and subtle opulence. It presents a generous trail whose heart collides notes which evolve on the skin with galvanizing synergy. “A magnetic, everlasting, and elegant elixir that no one can resist.” A vanilla-infused fragrance that is not sticky but rather powerful and modern, an addictive signature with strong projection at the opening that lasts. Elegance begins from the top with an aromatic combination of citruses and spices: orange flower, sparkling bergamot, warm cardamom, and evocative cinnamon.

name: Carlisle
description: A wave of freshness bathes the skin - Carlisle is the embodiment of light. Sunny and radiant, this sensual fragrance is built around a sandalwood theme that is warm, with a hint of vanilla, whilst both soothing and rich. The clear, seductive top notes of crisp green apple, warming nutmeg and golden saffron unearth the scent to an elegant heart of rose, tonka bean, osmanthus and davana. The perfume narrative is concluded by a base of vanilla, patchouli and opoponax resinoid - an olfactory for fragrance connoisseurs and lovers of niche fragrances.

name: Cassili
description: Joyous, sparkling, and spontaneous. This irresistible and delicious fragrance is a blend of velvety fruits and pastel flowers, with a sprinkle of vanilla and wood. Cassili is a truly original scent with a radiant sillage designed as a manifesto for new generations of aesthetes. The notorious plum note shapes and refines the Eau de Parfum; it is anti-conformist, indulgent, and lively while at the same time subtle, elegant, and classic.

name: Delina
description: A charming and firmly modern floral bouquet. Delina is a highly nuanced fragrance that is both sweet and sensual. The Eau de Parfum relishes in its floral accords which are dominated by Turkish rose, lily of the valley and peony, blended with the rounded tangy notes of lychee, rhubarb, bergamot and nutmeg. Vanilla accentuates the sensuality of the composition at the base, mingling with white musk, cashmeran, cedarwood and incense.

name: Delina Exclusif
description: This new take on Delina is an unprecedented captivating floral creation. The fruity opening notes of pear, lychee, and grapefruit provide intrigue. At the heart, a bouquet of rose Damascena paired with incense and vetiver captures the soiree in all its beauty. Set with a subtle base of vanilla, musk, and Evernyl, this Parfums de Marly scent is luminous and passionate and uses only the finest ingredients.

name: Delina La Rosée
description: Delina La Rosée is the younger and more vibrant eau de parfum of the olfactory signature Delina. With a touch of freshness that delicately brightens the skin, the scent is a blend of transparent water flowers, and peony. The olfactory narrative features a radiant citric top note of Italian bergamot, it is rich, soft, and fruity, before giving way to a grassier, balsamic scent. At the heart, the most precious Turkish rose essence is found, and at the base, Haitian vetiver is refined and harmonious with the subtle accompaniment of wood and white musk that envelops the senses.

name: Galloway
description: Galloway is the art of olfactory music. The shade and heat of pepper and citrus aromatics create a surprise within this discerning perfume. The heart notes are an injection of sweet iris and heady orange blossom. At the base is a warm musk, honey-like amber, and deep-wooded sandalwood, highly textured to curate a distinguished eau de parfum.

name: Greenley
description: Greenley is housed in a statuesque green bottle and modeled after its composition, reflective of pure energy and the fresh breath of spring. This olfactory signature draws upon nature to create a joyful whirlwind of fruit, citrus, bark, and sap which flows into a crisp, tangy green apple surprise. With a daring juxtaposition of nature’s finest materials, it is a rich, masculine fragrance that is designed to stand the test of time.

name: Haltane
description: "Haltane is a fragrance for a gentleman of today, inspired by the gentilhommes of the Chateau de Marly in the 18th century.” Julien Sprecher, Founder and Artistic Director of Parfums de Marly. Haltane is an original scent of both radiance and shadow. Its composition features a blend of rare and noble ingredients which revisit the tradition of 18th-century French perfume making. Its dazzling freshness and herbal top notes quickly yield a warm and smooth sense of leather with a symphony of precious woods. Soft and sweet, escorted by saffron, its praline accord is an ultra-contemporary spin on the mythical oudwood. Agarwood emerges in this veil of contrasts and imprints the skin with luminous refinement for endur-ing comfort. A privilege that is all about sensation.

name: Herod
description: Herod is personified by its blend of diverse notes, exuding a smoky vanilla scent. This eau de parfum opens on spicy top notes of cinnamon and pepper to then show its powerful heart of tobacco leaf, incense, ciste and osmanthus. These peppery notes are further surrounded by vanilla pods, musk, patchouli and woody accord at the base. An elegant and discernible perfume, for both men and women, it is the epitome of old-world sophistication.

name: Layton
description: Layton is a fragrance which captures the essence of the debonair. This seductive oriental and floral fragrance with an intense olfactory signature opens with bergamot and its tangy passion, while lavender and geranium blend into a fresh note, chic and chivalrous all at once. The intensity of the eau de parfum is further amplified by amber, enhanced by the natural elegance of pink pepper. Distinguished and addictive, Layton’s character is further carried by vanilla and precious woods, which develop through an intriguing note of caramelized coffee.

name: Layton Exclusif
description: Generous, spirited, and explosive, this Parfum asserts its strength and impetuousness. The striking new take on Layton is a deep, rich, and woody fragrance for the connoisseur looking to make an impression. Top notes of bergamot, grapefruit, and apple softly envelope the heart of cinnamon, lavender, agarwood, and geranium. The base is comprised of guaiac wood, sensual vanilla, and sweet cypriol. A revival of the traditional yet refined in its scent.

name: Oajan
description: Back in the olden days the Oajan was considered a powerful frame of war and riders nowadays do not hesitate to rely on him to win successive riding championships. The corresponding scent will please you with the sugary notes of Vanilla and Tonka beans for an unforgettable and suave olfactive journey.

name: Oriana
description: A gourmand, floral and fruity fragrance designed entirely as a variation on texture. A mille-feuille of flaky sweetness, softness, and sensuality. A sparkling and juicy opening of mandarin and Italian bergamot with a joyful orange blossom flower and blackcurrant heart leads to a flimsy delight of marshmallow and airy sweetness of Chantilly cream that is addictive. The ambrette and musk base notes add a carnal touch to the composition. A glowing delight.

name: Pegasus
description: True to its roots and fit for a gentleman, this scent has a woody and exceptionally distinguished signature. Pegasus opens up with a balance of fruit, wood and spice, developed from the blend of cypress, bergamot and heliotrope. Its heart offers a beautifully intertwined combination of jasmine, lavender, and bitter almond, creating a powdery, fresh fragrance. The base lingers on the skin, featuring vanilla fused with an oriental twist of amber and sandalwood.

name: Pegasus Exclusif
description: With distinguishing marks of serene virility and exhilarating power, this unique creation embodies the sensuality of the much-appreciated vanilla, fused with an oriental twist of amber, sandalwood, natural oud, and guaiac. All combined with floral heart notes of jasmine, lavender, bitter almond, and geranium, the scent boasts a fine balance of fruits and spices including bergamot, pink pepper, cardamom, and heliotrope.

name: Percival
description: Presenting a subtle balance of citrus and aromatic notes on a woody base, this Eau de parfum exudes a fresh, sensual and refined scent in an ocean blue bottle that will be remembered. Amongst the top notes, scents of bergamot and mandarin sublimate through a touch of aromatic water to offer a unique combination. The heart notes give Percival its character and depth through a blend of natural jasmine, violet and geranium, overlapping with lavender, coriander and cinnamon. On the skin, musk mixes with pepper, absolute balsam fir and, to give emphasis, woody spices are revealed at the base.

name: Perseus
description: Perseus is a luminous and refreshing creation, combined with a long-lasting sillage. The fragrance is characterized by a grapefruit citrus accord and a vetiver heart that come to life the moment they meet. The former immediately invigorates, its freshness electrifying the skin. At the same time, the earthy facet of the vetiver is revealed, refined, comforting, and sensual. Perseus’s trail is further enriched by ambergris and long-lasting dry woods. Perseus evokes early morning at the royal residence of Marly, at the moment when the sun’s first rays waken the château, warm its gardens, and make its fountains sparkle. A sun-kissed perfume, it celebrates the radiance of citrus. A unique morning ritual for a day of endless sunshine.

name: Safanad
description: A warm and velvety fragrance. This eau de parfum is born from sunlight. Safanad opens with orange, pear, and petitgrain essence and follows with a heart of jasmine samba absolute, ylang-ylang, and orange blossom, to develop a coveted scent. Amber, vanilla, and sandalwood further divulge at the base to create a warm, woody fragrance, weaving a trail of comfort.

name: Sedley
description: Light, forceful and fresh, Sedley is an eau de parfum capturing watery and aerial scents that offer a true olfactory journey, with a freshness that follows you everywhere. This classic yet modern fragrance is a blend of bergamot, spearmint, and watery accord, with geranium bourbon, lavender, and sunny notes. In the background, the ultimate woody signature embodies tradition mixed with contemporary aestheticism.

name: Valaya
description: A radiant aura and yet, an impalpable softness. This elegant floral-musky-woody fragrance created by Julien Sprecher is a unique play on codes, materials, and subtle contrasts. An evocation of the skin caressed by a veil of cotton. Fresh top notes such as bergamot, mandarin, and sweet white peach, leading to a blend of white flowers, settling on musk and ambrofix sensual base notes.

name: Patchouli Mania
description: Perfumer: Fabrice Pellegrin Inspired by the deep and sensual notes of patchouli, Fabrice Pellegrin has composed a fragrance with sensual and mysterious lines. At the opening, the fresh, gourmand, and aromatic notes of davana and green hazelnut blends with the spicy woody note of coriander seed. The warm, gourmand heart offers an addictive dose of cocoa, balanced with the deep, woody notes of clearwood® and tea. Finally, the woody, warm, and earthy base reveals a mysterious patchouli in harmony with the sensuality and roundness of Vetiver and cetalox®, for a deep and bewitching trail. Eau de Parfum concentrated at 17% – Alcohol made of Beetroot – Without Coloring – 93% Natural – Unisex.

name: Peche Velours
description: The sun is high, the air is warm, and on a crumpled tablecloth, a fresh peach is waiting to be bitten. Pêche Velours, that's the moment. The one where summer settles on the skin, sweet, tender, luminous. From the first notes, a juicy and velvety peach explodes in the mouth, melting and full of light. It evokes the still warm pulp of a fruit picked by hand, in the shade of a tree in the middle of August. Then come the flowers. Solar tuberose , powdery violet , delicate jasmine ... A white bouquet that dances gently with the heat, bringing a feeling of airy, almost cottony softness. Finally, the perfume settles, soothes. Sweet vanilla , light musk , silky sandalwood ... A comforting base that melts on the skin like a golden memory. The trail is tender, enveloping, subtly greedy — like the last bite of a summer dessert that you don't forget.

name: L'eau De Phaedon
description: L'Eau de Phaedon is a serene and tranquil scent suitable for the whole family. The floral opening blends white neroli and jasmine with fruity notes of yellow mandarin. Aloe vera and agave leaves add an aquatic, vegetable softness to the fragrance, which evolves towards a soft, comfortable woody musky base, for a “cocoon” effect.

name: Pluie De Soleil
description: Pluie de Soleil or "It’s raining Sun" is a fruity explosion and an ode to a Mediterranean summer. After a fresh burst of lemon and bergamot, white peach, strawberry and pineapple ripen in the heart notes, taking on the delicate floral nuances of freesia. Sandalwood, cashmeran and a drop of vanilla add elegance and comfort to the musky base.

name: Poivre Colonial
description: Tangy and transparent, this ethereal woody beauty opens with an explosive blend of grapefruit, nutmeg and peppercorns. The heart is a mix of dry cedar and spicy vetiver and warm and animalic cocoa beans. The base is oak moss absolute and patchouli with a backdrop of blond woods.

name: Tabac Rouge
description: Tabac Rouge is an Art Deco composition, inspired by the paintings of Tamara de Lempicka. It is a luxurious androgynous fragrance, conjuring up rising curling tendrils of incense and tobacco smoke. Turkish tobacco absolute is warmed by ginger and cinnamon with a hint of honey. Tabac Rouge drys down to a lush base of Siam benzoin and musk.

name: Phaesus
description: Floral Woody, Marine, Slightly Animalic Inspiration: Facing the Indian Ocean, the island of Sumba located near the island of Komodo, in the province of the Lesser Sunda Islands, has been known for centuries as the island of sandalwood . The island is home to one of Indonesia’s most beautiful breeds of horse : the Sumba , also known as the Sandalwood Pony . At dawn or sunset, beyond the lush vegetation of the frangipani -lined Indonesian jungle, the beach at Nihiwatu becomes the playground of the Sumba horses. At the end of their wild runs they love to cool off in the water and under the effect of the swell, their hooves leave the ground, they then begin to swim in the ocean offering mankind a timeless spectacle. The name: PHAE DON + SU MBA + S ANDALWOOD

name: Liqueur Charnelle
description: The five major aromas that give Cognac its unique flavor are vanilla, prune, caramel, orange and apricot... while the nose detects floral and fruity notes in its bouquet, such as dried linden blossom, vine blossom, dry vine shoots and pressed grape with hints of violet and vanilla. Inspired by this cornucopia of fragrances, Liqueur Charnelle is a voluptuous, deeply sensual accord in which the perfumer offers a "cognac bouquet" of spices, blond tobacco and powdery woods. Suave and vibrant pink pepper, elemi and black pepper enhance tonka bean and raspberry notes...

name: Mojito Chypre
description: A beach party… from Ibiza to Miami Pierre GUILLAUME revisits a historical fragrance family by boldly redrawing its outlines to offer a modern, hybrid composition. Though the scent is built around classic chypre ingredients — patchouli, vetiver, labdanum, vanilla and oak moss, its fruity aromatic accord adds an offbeat, playful touch. Lime, fresh mint, strawberry aldehyde and rum absolute make up an explosive, exhilarating mojito accord that conjures the atmosphere of beach parties and summer celebrations. As the scent quiets down, the chypre structure asserts itself with warm woods and sensual moss.

name: 02 Coze
description: 02 Coze by Pierre Guillaume Paris. A shortened olfactory pyramid for this first scent based on essential Canapa Sativa Seed Oil. The olfactory complexity of this extraction deserved a bold and original construction capable of bringing out all the facets of this rare and precious ingredient. In place of the head note, the disconcerting, captivating Canapa Sativa heralds a rich, warm juice. Its heart is vibrant with spices and precious wood pepper, pimento and coffee fuse and flame to announce the sensuality of ebony, the rich, bewitching sweetness of chocolate and the infusion of Bourbon vanilla pods.

name: 04 Musc Maori
description: Theme N°04: Musks Oriental Gourmand – Musked Milky-smooth Cumaru wood is refreshed with green notes of coffee tree blossom presiding over a contrasting accord on a black and white theme: white musk and cocoa bean come together in an unexpected harmony. The sweet, powdery smoothness of the latter, echoed by vanilla-scented Amber and Tonka Bean, responds to the pure and soberly sensual effect of the former. THE INSPIRATION Memories of childhood breakfasts, deliciously regressive. THE PERFUME A bowl of bergamot-sweetened hot chocolate with amber echoes. THE NAME Like a Maori tattoo with dark intertwined symbols on a clear background, Musc Maori by Pierre Guillaume Paris unites the whiteness of musk against the darkness of cocoa bean absolute.

name: 11.1 Indian Wood
description: Harmatan Noir an accord of lemon mint and Jamaican allspice on a woody floral base of cedar and dried jasmine blossoms. With Indian Wood by Pierre Guillaume Paris, the perfumer reprises the same aromatic-spicy logic by associating peppermint with nutmeg and cardamom. The woody, exotic character of the composition is based on a triptych of oak moss, fir balsam and sandalwood, bound with a drop of coconut milk.

name: 15.1 Hapyang
description: Theme N°15: Floriental Floral Aldehydes Hapyang is an explosion of powder and floral sparkles, with an endless trail. Aldehydes make magnolia and ylang-ylang flowers sparkle in a cloud of powder, enlivened by the sweet, exotic notes of this floral heart. Pearwood, benzoin and vanilla rise in a delicate oriental breath, enveloping the skin like a precious veil of shimmering silk. It was while discovering by chance a series of photographs depicting a dancer in a cloud of powder (by Jeffrey Vanhoutte) that the idea came to me: aldehydes should twirl in a huge cloud of powder!

name: 16 Jardins De Kerylos
description: 16 Jardins De Kerylos by Pierre Guillaume Paris. The minimalist elegance of a blend of fresh figs and sycamore wood, borne on the grassy freshness of a shady garden. The intensity of an ocean breeze sweeping across the burning rocks of an island in the Cyclades... a natural and luminous aesthetic. Green Fig, White Peach, Sycamore Tree, Tuberose.

name: 19.1 Neroli Ad Astra
description: 19.1 Neroli Ad Astra by Pierre Guillaume Paris. Ad astra (latin expression) : to the stars... Lifting and precise, Neroli ad astra is a white floral, luminous and aerial, in which the Neroli from Morocco and the Agave Flower from Mexico seem to have been harvested in the azure fields of an heavenly garden.

name: 26 Isparta
description: "The province of Isparta in Turkey is famed for its rose oil, obtained from a variety called "Isparta Summer Roses", which grows profusely in gardens and terraced fields on the soft mountain slopes. The roses are picked early in the morning when they are half-open and their fragrance is the strongest... intense, rich, slightly spicy." Behind wisps of burning resins, Isparta hides a woody rose embraced by a velvety animalic accord of red fruit, benzoin, calamus, and ambroxan.

name: 30 Alphaora
description: Theme N°30: Glam'moss Floral Amber Woody Tree Mosses is contemporary and glamorous Like luminous creatures undulating in the icy sky, the Northern Lights set the polar nights ablaze. Daughters of the solar winds and the Earth's magnetic field, their ethereal glow gives lichen, moss and snowy vegetation an extraterrestrial aura. Seize this moment, imagine a tree moss metamorphosed by the strange glow of the Northern Lights. An imaginary tree moss as complex as it is deep, revealing an amber warmth between sage, dried fruit and blond tobacco. The sweet sap of Hinoki Wood, the strange floral vapour of an albizia under the sun, crowned by the brightness of the blood orange. The name: A portmanteau word, invented in the purest PG style. First work (alpha) on the theme Glam'moss, the quest for a perfume-aura (ora) , tenacious and ultra diffusing, where the Mousse of Assam matches the blood orange (ora) .

name: 4.1 Le Musc & La Peau
description: A blend of seven different musks conjuring human skin is adorned with ylang-ylang, tonka bean, amber, cedar wood, rosemary, and a touch of vanilla. A skin scent to be worn alone or as a base, to customize your usual fragrance.

name: Animal Mondain
description: The 30's & Modernism, from Marlene Dietrich to Robert Mallet-Stevens "Between the spicy ardor of Coz" and the balmy and liquorish opulence of Liqueur Charnelle, Animal Mondain interposes itself as a new Tobacco in my production. Stripped of all artifice, it is a gender free olfactory creation inspired by the modernist architecture of a Mallet-Stevens smoking room. The bursts of laughter of a social society happy to feast there splits the tobacco volutes that stretch gently on the leather armchairs and along the pear tree and mahogany woodwork. Pierre Guillaume Paris.

name: Aqaysos
description: Aqaysos by Pierre Guillaume Paris is a versatile and elusive olfactory proposal, inspired by the incisive, shiny and brilliant character of crystal. Pierre Guillaume plays resonances between the ingredients, to distort our perception as a prism diffracts the light ... Between fluidity, transparency and sensorial impact, Aqaysos is an explosion of rising and fruity notes, on the rhythmic pulsations of a woody vibration.

name: Entre Ciel Et Mer
description: A MARINE POEM COMPOSED WAVE AFTER WAVE... Entre ciel et mer ("Between sky and sea") tells a story of etesian winds, azure skies and flying over seascapes at top speed... Icy, soaring and powerful, the first whiff feels as though it had been sculpted out of the Meltem - the north wind that blows over the Aegean Sea, with notes of crumpled, water-splashed leaves and the fruity-aromatic nuances of a lavender, pear and white thyme accord.

name: Intime.Extime
description: THE NAME intime Adjective and noun . Intimate, close extime Adjective and noun . Relating to the part of intimacy which is voluntarily made public (as opposed to intimate): An extime diary. THE PERFUME Intime.Extime, when a perfume says everything about you… Intime.Extime is a powdery, floral and amber skin adornment evoking the movement of the pages of a diary expressed by a Iris Powder accord , Incense and Vanilla . Itauba Wood , refreshed with a dash of White Tea , infuses its exotic complexity . A MATERIAL Itauba Wood , when freshly cut, gives off a complex and singular fragrance. A keynote of the Intime. Extime fragrance brings a depth and preciousness linked to the multitude of its exotic wood nuances.

name: Polaris
description: High above the shifting constellations, one light remains constant—Polaris, the star that has guided explorers, dreamers, and wanderers through the night.

name: Power Self
description: A unique formula scientifically designed to positively boost mental and emotional strength through targeted olfactory stimulation. POWER SELF, a unisex woody floral fragrance that creates an alluring and comforting sillage that resonates with your true self. More than a fragrance, POWER SELF is a functional composition that empowers you to be the best version of yourself. Become your super self.

name: Printemps Blanc
description: A luminous and irresistible fragrance that captivates from the very first note. Sparkling grapefruit and delicate orange blossom open onto an enchanting heart of jasmine and white tea, before melting into the addictive softness of vanilla and creamy sandalwood. An unforgettable trail you simply can’t resist.

name: Purple Stain Extrait Extrême
description: Purple Stain opens with the warm spice of saffron, cinnamon, and nutmeg, brightened by the fresh zest of mandarin and bergamot. The heart is rich and indulgent, blending the radiant sweetness of orange blossom with creamy caramel and vanilla. As it settles, the base reveals a deep, smoky blend of oud, patchouli, and cypriol, softened by the resinous richness of cistus and the woody elegance of akigalawood. Velvety and bold, Purple Stain is a fragrance that lingers, leaving a powerful and unforgettable impression.

name: Red Tobacco
description: Red is warm and mesmerizing. Red Tobacco is an incredibly potent and sexy fragrance that mixes Cuban tobacco and spices. A true heat wave.

name: Remain
description: Remain by perfumer Pierre Negrin A single dot - the origin, the pure potential, the spark from which creation bursts forth. Spices ignite the composition with green aromatic freshness, while carrot and bergamot add a golden glow. At the heart of this creation, vanilla emerges as a paradox, both raw and refined, primal yet velvety. Wrapped in the floral warmth of ylang-ylang and jasmine, it takes on a luminous, almost celestial quality. The base is a foundation of sacred frankincense, deep sandalwood, and castoreum, anchoring the fragrance in the very roots of perfumery’s history.

name: Cuir 404
description: "Leather — old, dark, smoky, heavy — is diabolically difficult to adapt to an accessible 21st-century format. Under the creative direction of Maselli, Wright and Eastwood, Francis Kurkdjian has succeeded masterfully. Rêve en Cuir is a delectable, edible, light-infused Leather that is instantly legible, deliciously impossible as if a Hermès belt had been candied and baked by a patissier. Technically perfect (it lasts and diffuses like clockwork), it is also an aesthetic triumph. Hermès’s own Kelly Calèche wonderfully modernized leather; Rêve en Cuir is even better, stronger and more daring. It is not just the Leather you never imagined — it is also the gourmand you never imagined." - Chandler Burr, The New York Times. Perfumer: Francis Kurkdjian

name: Risvelium
description: The scent of awakening, an inhale that fractures the ordinary and exalts the extraordinary. It draws from the unseen forces that bind the earthly and the ethereal, a bridge between the tangible and the transcendent. The soul's journey is both the question and the answer.

name: Rose Magnetic
description: Perfumer: Sophie Labbé The most sensual of all flowers displays all its facets in this creation — playful, addictive, and modern in turn. A hint of bitter grapefruit and fresh peppermint contrast against the lush femininity of the rose. Layers of lychee, natural cedarwood, musks, and natural vanilla bean add to its intoxicating appeal. At the core of Rose Magnetic is a combination of natural Rose Essential ™ LMR and natural Turkish Rose Absolute LMR, both certified “For Life.” Each is sustainably produced, to provide more stable wages to local communities. Eau de Parfum concentrated at 16% – Alcohol made of Beetroot – Without Coloring – 86% Natural – Unisex.

name: Rose Saltifolia EDP
description: Salty dunes, zesty ocean mist, fiery bougainvillea. Sparkly sea spritz. Pirouetting pink birds, imperial wind-blown Centifolia. Swirly sand, silky seaweed meadows. Undersea woods, crystalline moods. The defining adventure : a stroll on the seaside, among fields of freshly blossomed roses blown by the sea winds. The surprising contrast : sparkling and crystalline rose Centifolia meets salty and silky seaweed. Fragrance family : floral marine. Key ingredients : blood orange essential oil, pink peppercorn essential oil, rose Centifolia absolute, seaweed absolute, cashmeran. Concentration : 15%

name: Roses Musk
description: The name sounds so simple, but it says it all. Roses. Musk. Exquisite, dew-kissed roses in full, breathtaking bloom and soft, clean skin-loving musk that caresses the senses is blended with a hint of sweetness to create a rose scent that is absolutely divine and astonishingly airy and light. Like a flawless diamond in a solitaire setting, sometimes it's best to leave perfection uncluttered. Simply lovely.

name: Roses Vanille
description: Sweet enough to capture you, rich enough to keep you and complex enough to seduce you, Roses Vanille is an absolute standout and one of the sexiest floral gourmands you've ever smelled.

name: Rosso Rubino EDP
description: Rosso Rubino is intensity, elegance, and character. A fragrance that fascinates from the very first moment, like a deep gaze or a precious detail never forgotten. It is a scent rich in nuances, designed for those who love structured, radiant, and enveloping creations. A unisex, persistent fragrance with a complex, captivating structure where citrus, florals, fruits, and woods blend in harmony. The opening sparkles with bergamot, lemon, and orange. In the heart, rose mingles with berries and cocoa, creating a composition that is both elegant and gourmand. The base is deep and textured, with coumarin, pink pepper, patchouli, cashmeran, and oakmoss ensuring a sophisticated, enveloping, and enduring trail.

name: Rouge Smoking Extrait
description: Intensely sensual and captivating, Rouge Smoking Extrait draws its inspiration from the vibrant energy of Paris' Pigalle district. With a 30% concentration, this fragrance reimagines the cherry, amber, and tonka bean accord with depth and intensity. It embodies a passionate spirit where boldness and elegance come together.

name: Safran Secret Extrait
description: Safran Secret recalls a mysterious adventure lived by Thibaud Crivelli during which he discovered a saffron field shrouded in a very thick fog. This deep, sensual composition is as captivating as enigmatic. It sees the brightness of a comforting saffron contrast with the opacity of warm and highly-diffusive woods. Safran Secret is the new name of our fragrance previously known as Ingredients 07/2012, a creation that was offered exclusively to INGREDIENTS Prague to celebrate their 10th anniversary. Concentration: 30% Vegan creation In collaboration with: Gaël Montero

name: Saint-Honore
description: A captivating perfume inspired by the delicacy and sophistication of the famous French pastry, Saint-Honoré is an invitation to happiness. With its refreshing character, the perfume is unveiled by bergamot opening like a sunrise on a garden of citrus trees – a citrus note skillfully enhanced by a spicy touch of pepper. A symbol of purity and beauty, orange blossom brings a floral sweetness transporting us to the heart of a flowering orchard. Hazelnut, with its warm roundness and a milky chord, recalls childhood memories of freshly made pastries. The lingering trail of the perfume is a deep, rich balance in which musk pairs with vanilla to offer a creamy, enveloping texture. With its bittersweet nuances, the tonka bean adds a fascinating complexity and a last hint of sweetness.

name: Sakura EDP
description: Opening with sparkling notes of lime and mandarin tempered with pink pepper and a green accord, delicate cherry blossom with soft almond aromas enhanced with powdery violets and creamy vanilla. Elusive elegance, realizing the power of subtlety, radiating an inner confidence - to be worn with an innate love of understated good taste.

name: Santal Calling
description: Unstoppable spell Perfumer Antoine Maisondieu explores the unique properties of Sandalwood Album from Australia. His idea was to mix contemporary Parisian inspirations with the mystical energy of this ingredient to create a bright and soothing scent that leads to an ultimate addiction. Perfumer: Antoine Maisondieu

name: Santal Volcanique EDP
description: Glowing spice-clouds, acid ashes, tremors: burning adrenaline. Beyond-black slopes: parched ylang, scorched sandalwood and cedar. Cascading coffee, crackling cardamom, roasting ginger. Roaring softness. Inspiration: Discovering scorched sandalwood on the slopes of an erupting volcano. Contrast: A fusion between fresh spices and a sandalwood coffee accord. Perfumer: Richard Ibanez (Robertet)

name: Scintilla
description: Refined and bewitching, Scintilla by Giardini di Toscana is a real invitation to conquer. A brilliant opening of fruity notes gives way to a magnetic heart of iris and violet and jasmine. Rich woods and sophisticated amber notes such as Patchouli and Timbersilk envelop the fragrance for a completely unexpected experience.

name: Sensual Instinct
description: Sensual Instinct invites you to let your primitive instinct take over. A lush, warm and dense fragrance, that combines vibrant notes of roasted coffee with the mysteries of rose and creates a praline balance of mesmerizing sensuality.

name: Shabby Chic EDP
description: Shabby Chic is a fragrance that makes you feel good. Soft, reassuring, refined, it is like an embrace that stays with you, quiet and constant. A long-lasting, enveloping perfume that blends floral and musky notes into a delicate yet well-structured composition. It opens with velvety peony, leading into a tender, romantic heart of white florals and Bulgarian rose. The base of musks, javanol, and cedarwood creates a creamy, soft, and clean trail that fuses with the skin, lingering for hours. Shabby Chic is the scent for those who love to feel at ease, elegant, serene, and embraced by a chic, enduring signature.

name: Sicily
description: A mix of citruses - white flowers warmed together by sandalwood and cedarwood.

name: Silky Woods Gift Set
description: Silky Woods Christmas Limited Edition Set includes a 100ml Silky Woods Eau de Parfum with a complimentary matching 10ml Travel Spray. A more subtle, luxe, and modern interpretation of agarwood – one that is delightful to wear on any occasion and which offers the sensation of a distinctive woody fragrance on silk-smooth skin. Silky woods is delicate yet sensual and to enhance its oriental sillage of agarwood, suede, exotic vanilla, and smokey tobacco leaves, Goldfield & Banks adds to the perfume, saffron, incense, ylang-ylang, and Australian sandalwood.

name: Sparkling Jo EDP
description: ALL NIGHTERS All night long, all day long, from the evening until the next day, Sparkling Jo will set the tempo of your emotions and desires. And each day will only be better than the last. The Master Perfumer has bottled/captured the essence of party life by creating this scintillating perfume with hints of pear. This fragrance celebrates the joie de vivre of the most American of all Parisians. Jo herself.

name: Speed Legends
description: Living on the edge SPEED LEGENDS transcends time and space, embodying the relentless pursuit of speed. Inspired by the adrenaline of motorsports, it captures the essence of a thrilling journey. With each note, feel the rush of velocity and the mystical allure of the fast lane. Perfumer: Jordi Fernández

name: Spiky Muse
description: Muse turned artist The portrait of a powerful and creative femininity. The Rose, Queen of Flowers and eternal inspiration for artists, wraps itself into a new addictive sweetness created from a natural Strawberry extract - obtained through an innovative upcycling process - and a tasty Pistachio accord. Perfumer: Louise Turner

name: STÆLIOS
description: WOODY FLORAL - LEATHER THE NAME Stallion + Helios (Sun God). STÆLIOS is the brand's last creation before its 20th anniversary year. This fragrance is seen as a ‘balance sheet work’ , an emblematic Totem work, which is intended to become one of the fragrances forming the backbone of the House, as is Le Musc & La Peau. It's a vibrant, singular, powerful, radiant and luxurious fragrance in a bottle that doesn't belong to any existing collection. THE FRAGRANCE STÆLIOS is an eau de parfum saturated with woody and floral notes. Luxurious notes of Russian Leather envelop a Violet Wood soaked in a fiery Davana Liquor infused with Ashanti Pepper Leaves.

name: Starry Night
description: Shining like a star, Bergamot from Calabria lights the way to a floral heart of Bulgarian Rose and Egyptian Jasmine empowered by notes of Patchouli from Sumatra, and leaves a warm sillage of Sensual White Musk and Powdery Notes.

name: Story of Your Life
description: Story of Your Life is a fragrance that captures the essence of true love—an eternal, unspoken connection between souls. It opens with the warmth of benzoin and the ripe fruitiness of davana, evoking a sense of longing and hope. As it unfolds, it brings comforting notes of buttered bread and orange blossom, intoxicated by rum, vanilla, and cocoa. Amber woods and patchouli leave a signature that lingers like a second skin, embodying a love that returns, again and again. Created by Jérôme di Marino, this smoky-amber fragrance is a journey of reunion and timeless devotion.

name: Sugar Addict
description: Sugar addict opens with a dazzling burst of pure sugar, a crystalline rush that awakens the senses. Hints of rich cocoa, warm cinnamon, and creamy vanilla swirl together, creating a multi-layered sweetness that never feels cloying. A generous splash of rum adds a boozy depth, while cashmere wood weaves a luxuriously soft base. Subtle hints of coffee and labdanum add a touch of sophisticated bitterness, a reminder that true indulgence is about balance. Sugar addict is for the playful gourmand lover, the one who believes that a touch of sweetness can elevate any experience. Wear it alone for a delicious skin scent, or layer it with your boldest, most daring perfumes to create a signature that’s both intoxicating and uniquely yours.

name: Sun Cities EDP
description: Sun Cities offers a wonderful haven, a meeting between opulence and refinement, between history and desire. Don't think that it's a refuge or a great escape: it's a magical place where the heart and mind recharge their batteries. A powerful journey. Peacefully, the senses are awakened here. Like a call to greatness, your sacred fire reveals your secret desire. Between sun and opulence, between movement and calm, Sun Cities is a powerful creation that invites you on a quest bold. What do you dream of?

name: Sunset Hour Gift Set
description: Sunset Hour Christmas Limited Edition Set includes a 100ml Sunset Hour Eau de Parfum with a complimentary matching 10ml Travel Spray. As a blazing sun dips into the Indian ocean, the scent of fragrant native fruits pervades the languorous evening breeze. A heavenly cocktail of citrus and spicy delights awaits, giving way to a deliciously gourmand and sensuous floral heart. Best served at sunset hour!

name: Tabac Rose
description: 1. Made up of rose absolute from Turkey and a honey praline accord which makes it smooth and powerful. 2. Tobacco from the Balkans, labdanum from Spain and patchouli from Indonesia give the perfume its density. 3. Chypre, floral and indulgent. 4. Recommended for those in search of an intense floral chypre perfume.

name: Tales of Amber
description: Crafted around the purity of New Zealand ambergris, Tales of Amber is a warm, powdery and sensual Amber Extrait that captures scorched earth, sunlit resins, and mineral-warmed skin. With ambery-floral notes and oriental depth, it radiates sensuality through an overdose of Labdanum, golden, resinous, and unforgettable. Created by Goldfield & Banks’ founder Dimitri Weber in collaboration with French perfumer Suzy Le Helley, Tales of Amber balances innovation and tradition, drawing inspiration from the ocean’s mystery and Australia’s wild botanicals. As the fragrance unfolds, the Gourmand glow of Amber 83 deepens—its creamy sweetness a counterpoint to Ambergris’s animalic, oceanic intrigue.

name: Tanger EDP
description: A vivid display of neroli, playing to win your heart. The scent is a lasting tribute to the quintessential marriage of harmonious perfumed oils. Expertly blended with ylang ylang and bergamot, Tanger is a sunny, golden perfume, joyful and entirely lovable.

name: Blue Heart
description: Inspired by the remarkable Blue Heart Diamond and the joie de vivre lifestyle of the various socialite owners, Blue Heart expresses seductive and bewitching elements in this olfactive gem. Evoking an aura of mystery, the richness of Orris Root, sensual Tonka Bean, and a layer of Vanilla at the heart give this fragrance a multi-faceted texture, illustrating the radiance of the diamond structure.

name: Carved Oud
description: Inspired by a sixteen stage ritual for Indian Royalty, Carved Oud changes perceptions of what Oud fragrances can be. A rare and exclusive Oud has been blended to perfection, striking the right balance between earthy, floral, woody and sweet notes. The unique Oud from South Asia used in this fragrance is reminiscent of the fragrances burned in many of the precious temples in India to create a sacred environment.

name: Cullinan Diamond
description: The largest clear cut diamond in the world, The Cullinan Diamond is both magnificent and regal just as the fragrance it inspires. With the mysterious combination of Black Pepper, Vanilla, Rose and Musk, Cullinan Diamond recreates the warmth and dazzling brilliance of the Crown Jewels it adorns. This fragrance oozes regal warmth and is exquisitely royal, like the unique Cullinan Diamond its names after.

name: Green Pearl
description: This bright, radiant fragrance both effortless and energizing is inspired by the ‘Yemengzhu’, a legendary luminous Chinese Pearl of Green Fluorite. Found only in China, it is highly prized by the Chinese and said to bring health, great prosperity and good luck just by touching it. This fresh fragrance opens with notes of Apple and Citrus with a heart of Green Tea and Bay Leaves and base of lustrous Tonka Bean, Oak Moss and ambery Musk. Green Pearl is a vivid olfactory gem infused with verdant incandescence.

name: Patiala
description: Inspired by the mysterious Patiala Necklace of India created in 1928 for the Maharaja of Patiala, this fragrance has been created to elate and energize those who wear it. Like the necklace, Patiala is a manifestation of true craftsmanship and a mark of true sophistication. Warmth and elegance lie at the heart of this scent with Orange Blossom, effortlessly complimenting a rich and velvety Rose with a musky base.

name: Peregrina
description: Named after the most valuable Pearl in the world, this mysterious and seductive scent oozes royalty, stardom and sensuality. This perfectly shaped centuries-old Pearl was treasured by its owners, ranging from Mary I, the Queen of England, to the actress Elizabeth Taylor. The Rose Damascene blends beautifully with the white floral top notes making Peregrina a truly seductive fragrance that oozes sensuality and sophistication.

name: Regent Leather
description: Regent Leather was created in association with The Rolls-Royce Enthusiasts Club, engineered with the finest ingredients to be the best of its kind. Inspired by the Regent Diamond, the vanilla and leather notes in the base are reminiscent of the scent of the beautiful leather when opening the door of a Rolls-Royce. The Jasmine notes in the heart are reminiscent of the purity and flawless nature of the Regent Diamond.

name: Riviere
description: Riviere, inspired by a classic diamond necklace comprised of gemstones that are identical in size or seamlessly graduated, designed to embellish the skin with an elegant simplicity. Just as the necklace, this fragrance is inspired by balance and a flawless progression. Riviere progresses through rare and sparkling ingredients combined beautifully to adorn the skin.

name: Royal Sapphire
description: The bright blue Sapphires of the Crown Jewels are treasured by the British Royal Family Family and form are the inspiration for this enchanting fragrance. With the delicate combination of Bergamot, Mandarin and Amber, Royal Sapphire recreates the desired depth and dazzling brilliance of the Crown Jewels. This fragrance is Thameen’s Jewel in the Crown.

name: The Ghost In The Shell EDP
description: A fragrance from the future; where nature and technology meet and complement each other. A fusion of liquid-scented Aqual™ and Yuzu bring to life a citrusy metallic freshness. While the velvety skin and juicy fruitiness of peach and pear form a metaphor for human flesh and intertwine with a human heart of Jasmine. A hybrid, superhuman body, between natural and synthetic, whose vital force is born from the power of amber woods and the chrome minerals of moss.

name: The Hedonist
description: Destination unknown THE HEDONIST takes you on a journey through wild, untamed nature, celebrating its raw beauty. Inspired by dramatic landscapes and the power of telluric forces, it captures the essence of black stones and extreme temperatures. Each note invites you to reconnect with the earth’s primal spirit, offering a sensorial experience that is both grounding and exhilarating. Perfumer: Jordi Fernández

name: The Musc
description: Perfumer: Calice Becker At once fresh, honeyed, and warm, The Musc is a subtle blend of captivating scents. It opens with red ginger from Laos and natural lavandin grosso from France. Natural and sustainable beeswax absolutely brings a creamy sweetness to the heart, paired with a pure note of Nirvanolide musk. Australia’s natural sandalwood punctuates the blend with warm, woody tones. Replanted 20 years ago, Australia’s Sandalwood Album provides Aboriginal communities with protection and sustainability for their land. Eau de Parfum concentrated at 17% – Alcohol made of Beetroot – Without Coloring – 88% Natural – Unisex.

name: Tihota
description: Tihota is a fascinating work of a master perfumer who has perfectly captured the essence of the pure nature of fresh vanilla, harnessing it in such a beautiful way. An exquisite scent of Tahitian vanilla enveloped in sugar cane syrup, nuanced by a touch of white musk, evolving into a magical long-lasting drydown that inspires an obsessive devotion to those who wear it. The result is unique. An unbridled vanilla, sweet, raw and achingly desirable, whose delicious simplicity makes it one of the most coveted vanilla fragrances in haute parfumerie. Perfumer: Francis Kurkdjian

name: Tonka Cola
description: On the trail of this famous spearhead of pop culture, invented in the United States, we followed in the footsteps of caravans, travelers and kola nut merchants. This journey took us from the hectic modernity of the world's great metropolises to the warm plains of the sunset empires, where the tonka bean awaited us. Sweet and engaging, pop and elegant, Tonka Cola will catch you in the moment.

name: Torino 24
description: A scent that evokes the memories that come with the friendly indoor tennis match for Xerjoff’s fourth year as Silver Partner for the Nitto ATP Finals in Turin. The components that make up the match are captured in the blend, from the rubbery core of the tennis ball that bounces off the indoor court to the wooden tennis racket in hand. Deliciously enticing, TORINO24 opens floral and fruity with juicy mandarin , mango and plum that fuse with pink lotus absolute and orange blossom . TORINO24 draws to a warm close with moss , patchouli and white musk at the base. A playful scent that leaves the senses yearning for more.

name: Tubereuse Astrale Extrait
description: Twinkling night, fruity star. Telescope: cinnamon constellation, powdery comet. A milky, astral tuberose. Vanilla silhouette, peachy-soft skin, meteor shadow, leather nebula. A musky galaxy. Breathing in the scent of tuberoses while gazing at the Milky Way and shooting stars. Perfumer: Quentin Bisch

name: Tuberoza
description: Reveals mainly the captivating tuberose of Mexico which is accompanied by other floral notes like gardenia, marigold and jasmine. Strong ambery base is a guarantee for the distinctiveness of the scent.

name: Valaya Exclusif
description: Valaya Exclusif draws its inspiration from the minimalist, masterful silhouette that became the hallmark of French court dresses in the late 18th century. That neo-classical style dared to layer precious materials atop one another, mixing opacity and transparency and reconciling refinement and sensuality, also evoked through its white frosted bottle. A fragrance of refined luxury, exuding a powerful aura that embodies feminine elegance for contemporary aesthetes who desire it all. Valaya Exclusif, a unique yet universal floral woody creation, unveils almonds' sensual and velvety allure, the lightness of transparent white flowers, and the refined strength of creamy white woods. Enhanced by powdery notes, it radiates an enticing warmth and delivers a sensation of velvety softness that tenderly envelops the skin.

name: Vanilla Absolu
description: Vanille Absolu wraps around your senses like a gentleman draping a warm coat around your shoulders. It displays a thoughtful, elegant confidence while still keeping its gourmand sweet edge front and center. The vanilla, clove, and cinnamon are vivid, authentic, and artfully balanced, with a smooth and refined texture.

name: Vanille des Afriques Intensivo
description: The very definition of pedigree and heritage with its precious contents of Orris butter and an abundance of the aphrodisiac, Madagascan vanilla absolute. Vanille des Afriques Intensivo is a balmy evening, enjoying the sunset whilst the warm breeze billows through your silks and linens. Its smooth radiance soothes and relaxes you - a level of comfort and quiet contemplation.

name: Velvet Iris
description: Ode to the velvety petals of the flower, Dominique Ropion delivers a woody, carnal interpretation of the iris. It all begins with a breath of spicy freshness, rising like the majestic stem of the iris: pink pepper and turmeric leaf electrify buchu leaf with aromatic and herbaceous accents. Balanced by the crisp greenness of galbanum and lentisque, the precious iris concrete gradually warms on the skin, revealing more carnal inflections, both creamy and powdery. Sensuality blooms ever so softly, brought to life by the drydown of Velvet Iris: a woven from the milky notes of sandalwood, the warmth of labdanum and the contemporary vibrations of SaffianoTM, an exclusive IFF molecule that combines the power of leather with the softness of suede. A truly languorous experience, Velvet Iris reveals its powerful yet caressingly soft signature when worn. A hypnotic trail, elegant and infinitely carnal.

name: Verano EDP
description: One of the four scents from "The Four Corners of the Earth" collection that pays homage to various parts of the world. Montabaco Verano, with a dash of grapefruit and cashmeran, brings a touch of vitality and an added spring to your step.

name: Vesper Glitz
description: Paris la nuit VESPER GLITZ celebrates with radiance the airiness of an impertinent night out in Paris. The return of the exhaled Parisian after dark where souls freely melt and flourish in a flaming chaos of chimeric colors. Perfumer: Nadège Le Garlantezec

name: Basilico & Fellini EDP
description: The unmistakable smell of risotto bianco and a minty, peppery kick as the ultra fresh basil warms on the dish. A bon vivant who wanted to show life in all its glorious reality – people eating, sleeping and making love – Federico Fellini was said to request extra servings of this herb, rumored to be an aphrodisiac.

name: Black Citrus EDP
description: A sudden shower cooling the air: the romantic smell of London after a rainsquall when water has washed away frivolity, leaving only a zesty and triumphant breeze with a soft echo of the storm. The strength of bergamot, cardamom and violet is tempered by birch tree and a dusting of patchouli.

name: Dear Polly EDP
description: Distance is nothing to the heart: The scent of black tea, brewed just how she likes it, and the crispiness of morning light, slowly easing away the night that still clings to the senses. Ceylon black tea immediately warms the skin while sensuous musk simmers below.

name: Faces of Francis EDP
description: AN ODE TO INSPIRATION AND CREATIVITY What is the artist thinking about in his studio? He thinks back to this volcanic island, somewhere in the Mediterranean. He thinks back to the colors and smells of Tangier where pistachio mixes with saffron. He thinks back to all his past or imaginary trips that still awaken his senses. Inspiration is a journey between memories and desires in the present. Faces of Francis is a smokey gourmand – blending saffron, grilled pistachio, amber, and oud in a sweet composition that begs the question: what is inspiring him to create?

name: Mango Skin EDP
description: With a single bite, you can feel the mango in your veins. Wild colors, endless skies, and untamed happiness: breathtaking South Africa becomes the backdrop for this expressionist burst of blackberries, mango, and black pepper. A ripe fruit that reveals its complex flavors – a cocktail of wild orris, black lotus, and jasmine that leaves behind patchouli, vanilla, and a hint of pink sugar.

name: Moon Carnival EDP
description: LOVE TO THE MOON AND BACK His love was a dancer whose golden skin held the scent of passion and who loved tuberose more than any other flower. So he traveled the world in search of all the tuberose to fill the moon. For seven days and seven nights, the moon scattered this enchanting scent – pears, patchouli, ambroxan, orris, and musk – across the universe.

name: Morning Chess EDP
description: Bright endless mornings in a cottage, minds battling in wit over a chessboard: the memories of Jan’s summers shared with his grandfather. The ripe, green lushness of summer on the Swedish coast, where grassy notes are light enough to hint at the evergreen sharpness of the distant winter air.

name: Opus Kore EDP
description: Persephone had been warned there was a price to pay for her otherworldly love, so when she returns to the living, she brings a gift: springtime, a bracing gust of Sicilian lemon and acai that blossoms into raspberry blossom, pink magnolia and violet leaf followed by the sensuality of sandalwood, skin musks and crisp amber.

name: Poets Of Berlin EDP
description: Berlin, a city that is alive with the same kinetic, magnetic energy that attracted David Bowie for a few formative, recuperative and prolific years in the Seventies. Perpetual creative movement embodied in a bold collision of blueberry, lemon, bamboo, green wild orris and Haitian vetiver.

name: Room Service EDP
description: Picture this: Greta Garbo at Carlyle – a superstar who chose herself above Hollywood’s siren song. Alone in her hotel room, attired in a drift of satin and poignant allure, waiting for her ultimate luxury: a bath of flower petals, the warm water releasing this collision of citrus and red fruits, bamboo, violet, black amber and sandalwood.

name: 1861 Naxos EDP
description: Naxos celebrates Sicily's deep and sensual heart with a rich, spicy, vital perfume, imbued with tradition but striving towards the contemporary.

name: 1861 Renaissance EDP
description: Xerjoff 1861 Renaissance: Xerjoff Perfumes celebrates the 150 year anniversary of Italy's unification with the release of XJ 1861. Bright citrus notes begin the olfactory journey with lime, mandarin & bergamot representing the sunny Calabria region of Southern Italy. Fresh green middle notes of Lily of the valley and herbal mint capture the unmistakable fresh breeze of Sardinia leading to a base of Cedar, amber and musk which round out the entire composition, creating a warmth that is only felt in the beautiful Italian countryside.

name: 1861 Zefiro EDP
description: Xerjoff 1861 Zefiro: Zefiro pays homage to Rome's baroque alchemy, a fragrance with both the instant appeal and the grand mystery of such a prestigious capital, suggestive and elusive, vibrant and unknowable.

name: Blends Tony Iommi Monkey Special Parfum
description: Xerjoff Blends is the catalyst that unleashes creativity, merging sensory and cultural concepts to create a new reality where freedom is not in standardization, but in discovering oneself as unique. This Xerjoff Blends Rock Edition sees Black Sabbath's legendary guitarist, Tony Iommi, unify his monolithic riffs with Xerjoff's esteemed expertise to create the first multisensorial interaction primarily between music and perfume in an unexpected and unique olfactory venture. The Tony Iommi Monkey Special by Xerjoff Blends is what rock 'n' roll in the late 60s is for Iommi. Xerjoff pays homage to Tony’s Italian roots with tantalizing top notes of bergamot from Reggio Calabria, rum, Bulgarian Geranium, and passion fruit, opening to cinnamon, Bulgarian rose, and patchouli at the heart. Australian sandalwood, ambergris, vanilla, Tonka bean, caramel and musk are at the base, rounding off this olfactory journey in a luxuriously sleek and gothic bottle, available online and in selected retailers

name: 1888 EDP
description: Xerjoff Casamorati 1888: A rare and ethereal blend that transports the wearer to a bygone era of elegance and grace.

name: Dama Bianca EDP
description: Xerjoff Casamorati Dama Bianca – The White Lady is a story of a lady trapped within her dreams. High above the vistas, she gazes out into what could lay beyond. Locked behind walls of jealousy and deception, her only escape is the fragrant notes of fruits and flowers outside her reach.

name: Dolce Amalfi EDP
description: If the most breathtaking locales in the world are a combination of sheer beauty, but also of contrast and drama, then the Amalfi Coast's reputation is richly deserved. Colorfully elaborate structures are peppered throughout volcanic crags, and wildflower-lined cliffs carry winding roads that overlook narrow beaches astride azure-blue Mediterranean water, where luxury super-yachts dock next to simple sailboats. It's enough to make the world's greatest writers stand in abject silence and simply appreciate how beautiful a place can be.

name: Italica EDP
description: Discover the intoxicating charm of Italica , part of the Casamorati collection. Exclusively relaunched for Valentine’s Day, this beautifully romantic fragrance was made for those who love to love. Warm and full-bodied, Italica opens to creamy top notes of almond and milk, warmed by hints of spicy saffron and leading to a sweet heart of bourbon, vanilla and irresistible toffee. Notes of deep sandalwood and white musk provide a classic base. The classic Xerjoff Casamorati packaging has been reimagined with a focus on sustainability, while retaining the references to the Liberty style that distinguishes the brand’s history.

name: La Tosca EDP
description: Xerjoff Casamorati La Tosca: The fragrance was inspired by Puccini's famous opera composed in 1900. La Tosca was created to depict the beauty of the famous Italian opera and to celebrate a woman's passionate and romantic character.

name: Lira EDP
description: Lira is a femme fatale with gourmand vibes of caramel, sparkling citrus, refreshing lavender, and a soft spicy core composed of cinnamon and licorice, delivering an intoxicating twist. Lira is a simple fragrance with an enormous impact. It has been amplified by the fine fresh scent of caramel and vanilla, supported by soothing blood orange that lasts until dry-down, and deepened by soft spices. A clash of warm and sweet notes with juicy fresh fruits and narcotic Egyptian jasmine that composes a sumptuously romantic base. Lira is a mysterious, provocative and talented starlet.

name: Mefisto
description: Xerjoff Casamorati Mefisto: Italian oriental Mefisto is a tribute to classic italian colognes. Starting with fresh notes of grapefruit, lemon and bergamot.

name: Coffee Break Golden Dallah EDP
description: COFFEE BREAK is a perfume collection taking its inspiration from the intriguing, century-long history of the international coffee trade.

name: JTC 40 Knots EDP
description: Xerjoff JTC 40 Knots: JTC - Join The Club - includes ten perfumes representing ten different kinds of virtual clubs. No ordinary aquatic, 40 Knots captures the essence of the famous Italian yacht club and the Mediterranean air. One of Xerjoff's signature traits is an uncanny ability to harmonize the most extreme intervals -- sparkling aquatic top notes in perfect balance with the deepest, darkest bases - like the sea itself with a sparkling surface and fathomless depth. 40 Knots opens with a sea breeze, warmed by sun-kissed, vegetal greens and cooled by the surface of the salty water. The bracing, nearly menthol, salt note ebbs and flows through the entire dry-down, which gets darker, woodier, and richer with emerging notes of coffee, cedar, and clove. The crisp green and salty beginning softens to reveal a woody, slightly floral heart.

name: Torino 21
description: Xerjoff celebrates the prestigious partnership between the international Nitto ATP Tennis Finals and the city of Turin with the intoxicating notes of the new perfume, TORINO21 . Fresh and sophisticated, TORINO21 combines the green and aromatic benefits of mint, basil, thyme, and rosemary. The fresh, citrusy aspects derive from verbena and lemon, giving the greenery more energy and a touch of watery juiciness. Uplifting and vigorous, the composition also includes a crisp and elegant jasmine accord, blackcurrants, and a calming musk and lavender trail.

name: JTC More Than Words EDP
description: As Xerjoff's homage to literature and poetry, More Than Words is proof that the greatest phrases often come from unexpected combinations. Part sumptuous fruity floral, part complex resin-drenched oriental, More Than Words achieves true poetic balance with a composition that celebrates the individuality of its disparate elements without ever sacrificing the captivating blend of the whole fragrance. While an intoxicating accord of sweet fruit dominates the opening of More Than Words, it also indicates the unpredictability to come, with individual moments of smoky labdanum and wood creeping in just enough to surprise and enchant. As the sweetness dries, the fragrance bounds further into exotic territory, with oud and benzoin providing a warm, sensual backdrop. A waxing and waning frankincense brings everything together with such natural precision that it's easy to forget how bold the whole thing really is. Like all great writing, More Than Words is something more than the sum of its parts

name: Oud Stars Alexandria II
description: Alexandria- the thousand-year capital, among the very greatest and most enduring cities in history, and a shining center of history, culture and wealth. Now, Xerjoff endeavors to rebuild Alexandria to the height of its Hellenistic glory, gifting us a fragrance that overflows with rich fruits, spiced woods, and sumptuous florals that sing with the stunning accomplishments of this jewel of the ancient world.

name: Shooting Stars Apollonia
description: Apollonia is a homage to the space shuttle Apollo 11, through which the first moon landing took place, on July 20th 1969. This essence evokes the charm of the deep space, of a night sky illuminated by thousands of shining stars. And in its seductive scent one can perceive the yearning of man for infinity, the need to dream every time new worlds, a need that Apollonia perfectly satisfies involving all our senses in an intense imagination process.

name: Shooting Stars Cruz del Sur II EDP
description: Inspired by the mystery and majesty of the untouched tribes of the South American jungle, Xerjoff's Cruz Del Sur series radiates with compellingly fresh energy and the thrill of exploration. Our expedition has yet to locate the endless stores of gold we were promised, but we've already found indescribable wealth in the heart of the jungle. Lovers of deep, rich, juicy fruit scents, rejoice- Cruz Del Sur II is a sumptuous delight.

name: Shooting Stars La Capitale
description: La Capitale, dedicated to the city of Moscow and more in general to Russia, is a refined perfume capable of enshrining the charm of this boundless country rich in art, history and culture. At the same time, to celebrate the modernity and romanticism of Moscow, a metropolis made of thousands of different districts that all together create that picture of a rich and fascinating city, many times celebrated by the words of the great Russian poets, from Ivan Bunin to Aleksandr Blok up to Aleksandr Sergeevic Puškin.

name: Shooting Stars Nio
description: Aromatic fresh and woody, Nio is a refreshing walk through the south Italian countryside.

name: Shooting Stars Starlight
description: Created by Xerjoff’s master perfumers, this gourmand scent is an olfactory experience like no other. With top notes of citrus bergamot and fresh cardamom, it travels to a comforting heart of almond, cinnamon and clove for an irresistibly alluring warmth. The enticing base of cedar wood and amber features flaming balsamic accords that set the senses alight. In true Xerjoff style, this fragrance comes to life on the skin, revealing intoxicating hints of precious essences as time goes by. Discover Starlight, a rare and exotic journey through warming spices and sensual accords. This magical scent evokes the glow of a shooting star, with warming spices and seductive, sensual accords. With top notes of citrus bergamot and fresh cardamom, it travels to a comforting heart of almond, cinnamon and clove with flaming balsamic accords that set the senses alight. Bottled in an exquisite golden flacon with a mystical star motif, and beautifully packaged in a foiled box, this treasure makes the perfe

name: Shooting Stars Uden Overdose
description: Ten years after introducing Uden, one of the bestsellers in the Shooting Stars collection, Xerjoff is launching a powerful new version of the same perfume featuring a richer olfactive pyramid, UDEN OVERDOSE. Capturing the moment when the waves come crashing over the coastline, their blueness melting with the rocks, turning into foam, and returning to the sea. The moment when the perfume of bergamot lingers in one's memory, bringing back stories of Italian cliffs, the sound of crashing waves, and the hues of the sea. Finally, the contrast of coumarin and coffee notes, where earth, air, and salt water mingle on the skin to leave behind the fragrance of a leap into the fresh water.

name: Shooting Stars Uden
description: Uden is a complex yet clean and uplifting citrus scent with a floral and amber soul.

name: Shooting Stars Via Cavour 1
description: Xerjoff's Spotlight Collection exclusively presents Via Cavour 1. Opening to top notes with quince and white peach, this delicate perfume is followed by hints of Moroccan rose, dark chocolate, red berries and patchouli at the heart. At the base, oud, caramel, amber, Madagascar vanilla and musk warm up the senses . This scent is named after the street where our Turin store is located, which in turn is named after Conte Camillo Benso di Cavour. He was one of the protagonists of Italian Risorgimento , nicknamed " Father of the Nation " by no less than Giuseppe Verdi.

name: Torino 22
description: A scent whose performance thrills and exhilarates the wearer both on and off the court, Xerjoff presents TORINO22 , the invigorating perfume created to celebrate the Nitto ATP Finals for the second year running in Turin. Opening with green notes of bergamot and eucalyptus, TORINO22 leads to a heart of clary sage, and closes with a warm base of musk and dry woods. Powerful in spirit, TORINO22 mirrors the high-octane pace of the court yet remains crisp and clean in character.

name: "V" Accento EDP
description: Bursts of jasmine, iris, and pink pepper oppose the fresh pineapple, hyacinth, and citrus juice notes. The nocturnal floral patch has been mitigated by a dark and plush musky undertone and an earthy vetiver, embedding it in an ineffable mist.

name: "V" Accento Overdose EDP
description: Represents a new achievement in the field of a perfumery research aimed at making us feel always new sensations. Indeed, for the creation of this essence, it was used a molecule that amplifies the olfactory notes enhancing the fruity character of the original composition with a mix of green and balsamic notes. Also, the Jasmine Sambac, the Bulgarian rose and the lily of the valley enhance its romantic character. The magic of this perfume, charming for its aromatic intensity, is enclosed in a precious golden bottle of dazzling beauty. Abandon yourself to a journey of the senses with Accento Overdose, an intriguing perfume that enchants and delights. The aromatic compounds that underpin the sophisticated elegance are based on a blend of fruit-based essences enhanced by green and balsamic notes. The formulation's special molecule intensifies the fragrance's olfactory power for a celebration of the senses that is nothing short of perfect.

name: "V" Erba Gold EDP
description: Xerjoff is proud to announce that the captivating scent, Erba Gold, is now available worldwide . With a fresh new look on the outside and the same exquisite contents on the inside, Erba Gold opens to citrusy top notes of lemon from Amalfi, Brazilian orange and ginger, specked with a spicy heart of cardamom from Guatemala and cinnamon, which makes way for an enticingly warm base of white musk , amber and Madagascan vanilla. Erba Gold is presented with a unique silk neck scarf designed by Xerjoff and produced by famous silk manufacturers in Lake Como .

name: "V" Erba Pura EDP
description: A basket of most joyous fruits and fresh exuberant Sicilian citruses and Calabrian bergamot fill the composition with gaiety. A touch of fluffy musk and stark amber opens gates to the sensual and dreamy vanilla, warm and fluent, fresh and divine, Erba Pura is joie de vivre.

name: "V" Ouverture EDP
description: Noble cinnamon and delicious citrus foster floral a sonata of ylang ylang, seductive jasmine and mystical rose. A prominent touch of woody amber notes plus fuliginous incense and captivating vanilla herald a lush, luxurious and sweet oriental heart.

name: Xuxu
description: Sparkling - Decadent - Spicy A floral fruity musk with a touch of haute gourmand. Notre Chère Xuxú cordially invites you to experience a playful dance between two worlds—one that reimagines the regal codes of classic femininity. White suede musks, saffron and Mexican vanilla lay a sensual foundation for a royal bouquet of damask rose, steeped in Earl Grey tea and kissed by the decadence of a jammy blackberry macaron. Xuxú is then crowned with a burst of sparkling champagne, spiked with chilli pepper, and a twist of clementine peel; unfolding into a flirtatious and elegant composition.
